ancients.ALICE_FONTAINE.epithet: Author of the Teyvat Travel Guide
ancients.ALICE_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: If you meet a small girl with a backpack full of bombs, tell her Mother says to do her homework. Now, what does the Travel Guide recommend for someone in your position?
ancients.ALICE_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: The Fontaine chapter is mostly notes on the courthouse, which I recommend viewing from outside. Choose from the parts that got me arrested.
ancients.ALICE_FONTAINE.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.a: Oh, a climber! Let me find my notes. I have been meaning to add a chapter on this place, and you look like the kind of footnote that survives.
ancients.ALICE_FONTAINE.title: Alice
ancients.ALICE_INAZUMA.epithet: Author of the Teyvat Travel Guide
ancients.ALICE_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: If you meet a small girl with a backpack full of bombs, tell her Mother says to do her homework. Now, what does the Travel Guide recommend for someone in your position?
ancients.ALICE_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: I was banned from Inazuma once. Twice, actually. The chapter is excellent regardless. Pick a page.
ancients.ALICE_INAZUMA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.an: Oh, a climber! Let me find my notes. I have been meaning to add a chapter on this place, and you look like the kind of footnote that survives.
ancients.ALICE_INAZUMA.title: Alice
ancients.ALICE_NATLAN.epithet: Author of the Teyvat Travel Guide
ancients.ALICE_NATLAN.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: If you meet a small girl with a backpack full of bombs, tell her Mother says to do her homework. Now, what does the Travel Guide recommend for someone in your position?
ancients.ALICE_NATLAN.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: The Natlan chapter took three rewrites and one volcano. Take something from it; the volcano cannot have been for nothing.
ancients.ALICE_NATLAN.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.anc: Oh, a climber! Let me find my notes. I have been meaning to add a chapter on this place, and you look like the kind of footnote that survives.
ancients.ALICE_NATLAN.title: Alice
ancients.ALICE_SUMERU.epithet: Author of the Teyvat Travel Guide
ancients.ALICE_SUMERU.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: If you meet a small girl with a backpack full of bombs, tell her Mother says to do her homework. Now, what does the Travel Guide recommend for someone in your position?
ancients.ALICE_SUMERU.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: The Akademiya banned the Travel Guide, which doubled its sales. Here is a page they especially hated.
ancients.ALICE_SUMERU.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.anc: Oh, a climber! Let me find my notes. I have been meaning to add a chapter on this place, and you look like the kind of footnote that survives.
ancients.ALICE_SUMERU.title: Alice
ancients.APEP_SUMERU.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: Enter, mortal. Nothing that passes through me leaves unchanged.
ancients.APEP_SUMERU.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Deshret tried to build a paradise on my back. You want only a boon. That much I can grant.
ancients.APEP_SUMERU.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.anci: The sands have swallowed kingdoms, and I have swallowed the sands. What is one more mortal, taken in and returned stronger?
ancients.APEP_SUMERU.title: Apep
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0.ancient: I collect what others leave behind.
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: You'd have loved the Palais's lost property office.
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-0.ancient: I collect what others leave behind.
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: Oh! Have you seen any little round bombs? I dropped one...
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0.ancient: I collect what others leave behind.
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: Then you'd get on with quartermasters. We never throw anything away.
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-0.ancient: I collect what others leave behind.
ancients.DARV.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: Found a whetstone, by any chance? Mine's about worn through.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: The storm has passed over Mondstadt, and I remain. Choose, traveler, before the wind changes.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Once I feared every hand that reached for me. Reach anyway. The choice is yours to make.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.talk.ANY.2-0.ancient: The Spire is not the sky, but it climbs the same way. Take your first breath of it here.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.talk.ANY.3-0.ancient: I have lain beneath Stormterror's Lair long enough to know a beginning when it walks in.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.talk.ANY.4-0.ancient: A dragon's gift is a small wind at your back. It is all I have, and it is enough.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0: You carry the scent of the wind that woke me. Take what a wounded sky can spare, and go.
ancients.DVALIN_MONDSTADT.title: Dvalin
ancients.EGERIA_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: Abundance was my sin and my reason. Let some of it fall on you before the judgment falls on me.
ancients.EGERIA_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: My Melusines were born from a giant's tears. From what shall your fortune be born? Choose.
Every river in Fontaine began as a gift I was not permitted to give. I give it anyway. Take your share.
ancients.EGERIA_FONTAINE.title: Egeria
ancients.ELYNAS_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: The Melusines grew from my wounds. So can you. Take from me, and be whole.
ancients.ELYNAS_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: They tell me I fell from the sky. I only remember the ground, and the small ones who tended it. Let me tend you.
I dreamed of the sea before Fontaine had a name. Come, little one. The dreaming body has strength to spare.
ancients.ELYNAS_FONTAINE.title: Elynas
ancients.GREATER_LORD_RUKKHADEVATA_SUMERU.talk.AN: Wisdom is not withheld, only offered to those who arrive. You have arrived. Take what the branches carry.
I gave away everything, even my name, so the forest might keep growing. One more gift will not hurt.
ancients.GREATER_LORD_RUKKHADEVATA_SUMERU.talk.fi: The forest remembers what the city forgot. Come. What grows here grows for everyone who climbs.
ancients.GREATER_LORD_RUKKHADEVATA_SUMERU.title: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
ancients.IOROI_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: The kitsune host with ceremony. We tanuki host with sake. Choose whichever you find on the table.
ancients.IOROI_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Nothing in Chinju Forest is what it seems, except the food. The food is real. Eat.
ancients.IOROI_INAZUMA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.an: Ha! A guest who did not get lost in my forest. That deserves a drink. Or a meal. Or both. Pick.
ancients.IOROI_INAZUMA.title: Ioroi
ancients.KING_DESHRET_SUMERU.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: The desert keeps every bargain. So do I. Choose what you will give up.
ancients.KING_DESHRET_SUMERU.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Gurabad, Ay-Khanoum, Sabzeruz. Names of things I bought too dearly. Buy something smaller from me.
ancients.KING_DESHRET_SUMERU.talk.ANY.2-0.ancient: Knowledge is never free. The Eremites learned that from my sands. You will learn it here.
I sought forbidden knowledge and paid for it with my kingdom. Take a smaller lesson. It still costs.
ancients.KING_DESHRET_SUMERU.title: King Deshret
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: The adepti keep a contract with Liyue, and I keep mine with any who climb. Choose, then.
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Mt. Aocang has watched a thousand ascents. Most were foolish. Some were not. Which are you?
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.talk.ANY.2-0.ancient: Do not thank me. A gift given at the foot of a climb is only the mountain's toll paid forward.
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.talk.ANY.3-0.ancient: I have sat still for centuries and learned little. Perhaps motion teaches better. Go and see.
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.talk.ANY.4-0.ancient: Rex Lapis is gone, and still the contracts hold. Here is mine: one gift, then the road.
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.talk.firstVisitEver.0-: Hm. A mortal at the foot of the mountain, and the tea not yet cool. Very well. Choose your provision.
ancients.MOON_CARVER_LIYUE.title: Moon Carver
ancients.NEOW.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0.ancient: A performer. How bright you burn.
ancients.NEOW.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: Oh! Well. Thank you. Do you say that to everyone?
ancients.NEOW.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: Don't worry! I haven't lit the fuse yet.
ancients.NEOW.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0.ancient: A strategist. Your mind is very busy.
ancients.NEOW.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: It usually is. You're welcome to the quiet parts, if you find any.
ancients.NEOW.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: Grand Master, if we're being formal. Let's not.
ancients.NONUPEIPE.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0.ancien: You wear a crown you set down.
ancients.NONUPEIPE.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: I set it down on purpose. My neck is much happier.
ancients.NONUPEIPE.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: I made these myself! Mom showed me how.
ancients.NONUPEIPE.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0.ancien: You carry a whole island on your back.
ancients.NONUPEIPE.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: Only some days. Today it's mostly a satchel.
ancients.OCH_KAN_NATLAN.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: A dragon does not die all at once. Take a piece of me, then, and make it count.
ancients.OCH_KAN_NATLAN.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: My scales bought Natlan its dawn. One more will buy you yours.
ancients.OCH_KAN_NATLAN.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.a: The Night Kingdom is claiming me, piece by piece. Before it takes the last, let me give some of it to you.
ancients.OCH_KAN_NATLAN.title: Och-Kan
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0.ancient: Your trinket hums. Let me make it sing.
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: As long as it's in tune. I'll know if it isn't.
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-0.ancient: Your trinket hums. Let me make it sing.
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: Ooh! Can you make it go [i]boom[/i] louder?
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0.ancient: Give me what you carry. I will make it stranger.
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: Stranger is fine. Tell me what it does first.
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-0.ancient: Your trinket hums. Let me make it sing.
ancients.OROBAS.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: Teach it a drinking song and we have a deal.
ancients.OROBASHI_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: The Tatarigami whisper that a god should keep what is his. I never listened. Take what you need.
ancients.OROBASHI_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Watatsumi still eats because I stopped breathing. Let a little of that bargain feed you as well.
ancients.OROBASHI_INAZUMA.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0: I chose my ending long ago, beneath Yashiori. Whatever remains of me is yours, if you can carry it.
ancients.OROBASHI_INAZUMA.title: Orobashi
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0.ancient: You have bitten off more than you can chew.
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: Did anyone ask you? No. I didn't think so.
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-0.ancient: You have bitten off more than you can chew, little one.
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: But I haven't eaten anything! Do you have snacks?
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0.ancient: You are smaller than your ambitions.
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: Most generals are. That's why we bring friends.
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-0.ancient: You have bitten off more than you can chew.
ancients.PAEL.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: Ha! I've had worse odds. Let's see what we're dealing with.
ancients.REMUS_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: Power arrives with its price already written. Read the terms, then sign.
ancients.REMUS_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: I raised a golden city on borrowed harmony, and the sea collected. Choose carefully what you borrow.
ancients.REMUS_FONTAINE.talk.ANY.2-0.ancient: The symphony was worth the drowning. I still believe that. Perhaps you will believe it too.
ancients.REMUS_FONTAINE.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0.a: Every gift I gave Remuria carried a debt. None of them refused. Will you?
ancients.REMUS_FONTAINE.title: Remus
ancients.TANX.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: Glory? Please. Have you read my reviews?
ancients.TANX.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: I'm looking for treasure! I'll bring some back for everyone.
ancients.TANX.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0.ancient: Do you lead from the front?
ancients.TANX.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: When I must. I'd rather stand where I can see everything.
ancients.TANX.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: A good story never hurts. But first, I've got people to bring home.
ancients.TEZCATARA.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: That's... actually very kind. Thank you.
ancients.TEZCATARA.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: It's so warm! Dodoco, come closer!
ancients.TEZCATARA.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: Thank you. It's been a long climb, and I'll take the warmth.
ancients.TEZCATARA.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: Gladly. It's been a long winter up north.
ancients.TEZCATARA_NATLAN.epithet: A Wayob of the Night Kingdom
ancients.TEZCATARA_NATLAN.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: Hospitality is the oldest law of the tribes. Take a seat by the fire, and take something for the road.
ancients.TEZCATARA_NATLAN.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: The living pass through the Night Kingdom too quickly to taste anything. You will not make that mistake.
ancients.TEZCATARA_NATLAN.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0: Sit. Eat. The Night Kingdom has long tables and few guests, and you look like one who forgets to rest.
ancients.TEZCATARA_NATLAN.title: Tezcatara
ancients.THE_SACRED_SAKURA_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.0-0.a: The shrine is quiet tonight. Set down what you carry, and let the roots refine it.
ancients.THE_SACRED_SAKURA_INAZUMA.talk.ANY.1-0.a: A blade is polished a thousand times before it is trusted. Your thousand times begin here.
ancients.THE_SACRED_SAKURA_INAZUMA.talk.firstVisi: The petals fall and I remain. Lay your burden at my roots; what you hold will leave stronger than it came.
ancients.THE_SACRED_SAKURA_INAZUMA.title: the Sacred Sakura
ancients.VAKUU.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1.char: Show me what you have. And don't tell me it's priceless; everyone says that.
ancients.VAKUU.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1.char: You can have this shiny pebble! But Dodoco stays with me.
ancients.VAKUU.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1.char: Gladly. Show me the terms, then the small print.
ancients.VAKUU.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1.char: I have a stack of unsigned reports. I'll pay you to take them.
ancients.XBALANQUE_NATLAN.talk.ANY.0-0.ancient: A warrior who stops sharpening is already dead. Give me your blade.
ancients.XBALANQUE_NATLAN.talk.ANY.1-0.ancient: Natlan was not built by the strong. It was built by those who kept fighting after strength ran out.
ancients.XBALANQUE_NATLAN.talk.firstVisitEver.0-0: The flame does not care what you were. It cares what you become. Show me what you carry, and I will make it burn hotter.
ancients.XBALANQUE_NATLAN.title: Xbalanque

characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.aromaPrinciple: [sine][blue]The show must go on, and I am its star![/blue][/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.banter.alive.endTurnPing: Places, everyone! The curtain waits for no one!
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.bestiaryQuote: This one has yet to see my performance.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.cardsModifierDescription: Furina cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.description:
The Regina of All Waters.
She played a god for five hundred years and was very good at it. Now she chooses her own roles, and the Spire is the biggest stage she has ever seen.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.eventDeathPrevention: The audience still needs its Regina!
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough for a whole new season at the opera house...[/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.bossEntry: So you're the headliner? Fine. Let's see who they came to see.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.bossKill: Ha! Did you see that? Tell me someone saw that.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.lowHp: I'm fine! I'm... fine. Keep going.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.pair.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI: A strategist! Do you need a dramatic entrance? I have several.
Only one, please. On my signal.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.pair.KLEEMOD-YAE.ow: Only if I get the cover.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.pair.KLEEMOD-YAE.pa: Smile for the readers, Furina. You're in next month's issue.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.runLoss: So that's the ending. I really thought there'd be another act.
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.story.runWin: Curtain! Now, who's writing the review?
characters.KLEEMOD-FURINA.title: Furina
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.bestiaryQuote: I haven't seen this one before. Do you think it bites?
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.cardsModifierDescription: Klee cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.description:
The Spark Knight of Mondstadt.
Mom says there's treasure up there! Klee packed Dodoco, some snacks, and lots of bombs. We're going all the way to the top!
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.eventDeathPrevention: I'm still here! Don't leave without me!
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.goldMonologue: [sine]Enough for bomb supplies... and snacks for everyone![/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.bossEntry: Whoa, look how big it is! Stand back, Dodoco!
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.bossKill: We did it! Did you see, Dodoco?
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.lowHp: Ow... Can we rest for a little bit?
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.pair.KLEEMOD-FURINA.p: A little explosion would make a fine finale.
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.pair.KLEEMOD-VARKA.pa: Spark Knight. Same orders as always.
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.runLoss: Jean... can you come get me?
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.story.runWin: I made it all the way up! Mom's gonna be so proud!
characters.KLEEMOD-KLEE.title: Klee
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.aromaPrinciple: [sine][blue]Give me a moment. I'll find the way through.[/blue][/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.bestiaryQuote: I have no notes on this one yet.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.cardsModifierDescription: Kokomi cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.description:
The Pearl of Wisdom.
Watatsumi's priestess and strategist. She would rather solve a hard problem quietly than give a speech, and the Spire is the hardest one yet.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.story.bossEntry: So this is what holds the floor. Let's watch how it moves first.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.story.lowHp: I'm all right. Hold on a little longer.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.story.runLoss: I misjudged it. I hope whoever climbs next finds my notes.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.story.runWin: Done. Now I would very much like a quiet afternoon.
characters.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.title: Kokomi
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.aromaPrinciple: [sine][green]Tempting... but I've still got people counting on me.[/green][/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.bestiaryQuote: Haven't fought one of these yet. Should be interesting.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.cardsModifierDescription: Varka cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.description:
The Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.
He led the Knights north against the Abyss, leaving Mondstadt in Jean's care. The Abyss's trail runs up the Spire, so up he goes.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.eventDeathPrevention: Ha! It'll take more than that to get rid of me.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.goldMonologue: [sine]This will keep the Knights fed through the winter...[/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.story.bossEntry: Well, you're a big one! Let's make some room.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.story.bossKill: Someone write that down. Not me!
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.story.lowHp: Easy now. I've got another round in me.
The Grand Master himself! Do try not to upstage me.
See that gap on the left? Bet I can get us through.
I see it. Go ahead; I'll cover you.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.story.runLoss: Tell Jean... we're running a little late.
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.story.runWin: Knights of Favonius, we're going home!
characters.KLEEMOD-VARKA.title: Varka
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.aromaPrinciple: [sine][purple]How tempting. I think I will pass.[/purple][/sine]
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.banter.alive.endTurnPing: Take your time. I am enjoying this.
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.bestiaryQuote: Hmm. That one would make a fine chapter.
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.cardsModifierDescription: Yae Miko cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.description: Guuji of the Grand Narukami Shrine and editor-in-chief of the Yae Publishing House. Her Sakura strike at the end of every turn, and her edits make good cards better.
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.eventDeathPrevention: Oh my. Not quite the ending I had in mind.
characters.KLEEMOD-YAE.title: Yae Miko

events.ANGELS_SHARES_TASTING_FLIGHT.pages.INITI: The Angel's Share keeps a back-room tasting flight nobody orders unless Charles vouches for them personally. Three cups sit on the bar: a bone-pale tea that sharpens a duelist's opening stance, a bitter ember-red brew that a Knight swears kept her arm strong through five straight bouts, and a free cup Charles pours with a warning look that you should probably heed.

events.ARANARAS_TWO_CAPS.pages.INITIAL.descript: Off the trail in Ardravi Valley, an Aranara called Arapacati tugs your sleeve toward a hollow beneath a rotting Zaytun stump. Two fungi have grown there side by side: one swollen and pale as a drum, one small and giving off a sweet, resinous smell that carries further than it should. The Forest Rangers say everything edible in the rainforest is also, in some sense, a test. "Nara must choose," Arapacati says. "Aranara will not choose for Nara."
Obtain Bulging Cap (Big Mushroom, relic). Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 20. At the start of each combat, draw 2 fewer cards.
Obtain Rukkhashava Bloom (Fragrant Mushroom, relic). Upon pickup, lose 15 HP and Upgrade 3 random cards.
events.ARANARAS_TWO_CAPS.title: The Aranara's Two Caps
events.ARANWID_ELDEST_OF_VANARANA.pages.INITIAL: In the dream-lit hollow of Vanarana, past the singing seelie-lamps of Vissudha Field, sits an Aranara so old its leaves have gone silver. Around it lies a nest of small kept things — gifts from Nara who passed through and never came back for them. "Aranara remember," it hums. "Nara gives, Aranara gives back."
events.ARANWID_ELDEST_OF_VANARANA.title: Aranwid, Eldest of Vanarana

events.BANKED_FORGE_AT_MUSOUJIN.pages.INITIAL.d: A field forge under a tarp in Musoujin Gorge, banked low so the Kujou patrols upriver see no smoke. The resistance quartermaster has more scavenged gear than hands to carry it, and a Watatsumi smith who would rather make one good thing than inventory two poor ones. The Divine Priestess's standing order, she reminds you, is that nothing on Yashiori gets wasted twice. She holds out both hands and waits.

events.BLADE_IN_THE_STONE_FOREST.loss: {character} did not surface from the cold shallows at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
Half-submerged among the pillars of Guyun Stone Forest stands a blade driven hilt-first into bedrock, old enough that a Millelith patrol logs it on every pass and does nothing else about it. A Treasure Hoarder has been eyeing it for a week and finally admits he can't shift it alone. "Pull it and it's yours, free and clear," he says, "or leave the sword be and just work the shallows with me — there's coin enough down there either way, if you don't mind the cold."
events.BLADE_IN_THE_STONE_FOREST.title: The Blade in the Stone Forest
events.BLADE_THAT_BREATHES.pages.INITIAL.descri: A blade left out on a Tepeacac Rise slope has picked something up that moves along the steel like it's breathing. The Children of Echoes know this for what it is and don't flinch from naming it: take it up and it hits harder for what it costs you every swing, or burn it clean and let the weapon become something else entirely.
events.BLADE_THAT_BREATHES.title: The Blade That Breathes
events.BLOCKADE_LARDER.loss: {character} was buried in the salt of the [gold]{event}[/gold].
events.BLOCKADE_LARDER.pages.GORGE.description: Choose 2 of 8 random Common cards to add to your Deck. The eight crocks never repeat.
events.BLOCKADE_LARDER.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: Watatsumi's resistance sealed this sea-cave larder when the Sakoku Decree cut the supply lines, and nobody ever came back for it. Eight crocks of fermented stores line the shelf under the salt-crust, no two the same pickle. Deeper in, one crock was not stored — it was buried, on purpose, wrapped in a soldier's sash.
events.BLOCKADE_LARDER.pages.INITIAL.options.GO: Choose 2 of 8 random Common cards to add to your Deck. The eight crocks never repeat.
events.BLOCKADE_LARDER.pages.INITIAL.options.SE: Lose 14 HP clawing through packed salt and brine. Obtain the Ceremonial Crock (The Chosen Cheese): at the end of combat, gain 1 Max HP.

events.BLOCKADE_LARDER.title: The Blockade Larder
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.EXTRACT_CURREN: You pull free with your arm slick to the elbow, and the drummer stops mid-beat. The clan pays out the wager without complaint.
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.EXTRACT_INSTEA: You pull free with your whole side aching, and the drummer stops. The clan pays out the biggest wager of the season and says nothing about the heart.
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.INITIAL.descri: In the high meadows of Tequemecan Valley grows a flower the size of a war-drum, and the Flower-Feather Clan has been daring each other into it for a generation. Reach past the outer petals and the nectar runs sweet and easy. Reach again, and the bud tightens around your arm like it means it. The clan's oldest racer grins at you over the rim: "Third reach or nothing, if you've got the nerve for the heart of it."
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.INITIAL.option: Lose 5 HP. Advance to the next level.
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.POLLINOUS_CORE: The flower shudders and lets go. What you hold is warm, heavy and humming, and every Flower-Feather warrior in the meadow is looking at it.
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.REACH_DEEPER_1: Past the outer petals the nectar thickens and the flower closes a little around your arm. The clan's drummer starts a slow beat: the count for how long you keep it in.
Lose 6 HP. Advance to the next level.
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.pages.REACH_DEEPER_2: Shoulder-deep now. The drumming is faster, the petals are tight enough to bruise, and something at the flower's heart is warm and pulsing under your fingers.
Lose 7 HP. Obtain the Bloom's Heart.
events.BLOOM_OF_TEQUEMECAN.title: The Bloom of Tequemecan
events.BOUROU_VILLAGE_MEDICINE_RUN.pages.INITIA: Rain hammers the terraces above Bourou Village. A runner for Sangonomiya's field infirmary is crouched under a torii with a soaked satchel — a Shogunate patrol took the rest of her shipment on the coast road, and she has stopped pretending she will reach the front tonight. What survived is what nobody wanted: home-pressed sea-grass draughts, and one small vial out of Ritou she was told not to open.
events.BOUROU_VILLAGE_MEDICINE_RUN.title: The Bourou Village Medicine Run

events.BRAMBLE_LINE_BELOW_WOLVENDOM.pages.INITI: The Knights' patrol trail past Wolvendom has gone to bramble since the wolves reclaimed the ridge, and the duty Knight will not swear to what is on the other side. She offers two regulations: push through at your own risk, or make camp and let her post a watch — though something is already moving in the wet undergrowth nearby.
Make camp in the lee of the ridge. Heal HP (rest site amount). The wet undergrowth begins to move — Fight 4 Bramble Wrigglers (Wrigglers).

The clerk stamps the surrender, the appraiser countersigns, and the technique changes hands at the customs gate. "Per the charter."
events.BUREAU_OF_RECLAIMED_MEDICINE.pages.INITI: A Qixing licensing clerk has set up a confiscation desk at the Harbor customs gate, with a Northland Bank appraiser standing by to certify the trade. "Unlicensed brews get surrendered, per the harbor charter," the clerk recites, "and in exchange, a technique — upgraded, and yours to keep." He reaches for the first three flasks on your belt, leftmost first, and names the rarity of each before you've said a word.

events.CANOPY_ELDERS_LEDGER_OF_GIFTS.pages.INIT: An elder of the Scions of the Canopy keeps a nest of everything the forest has handed back to her over a long life, high in the branches of Coatepec Mountain. She trades plain: give something, get something, no counting owed either way. A potion earns a relic. A hundred coin earns a relic. And if you've got something rarer to offer — she won't name it for you, but she'll know it when she sees it — she'll match it with two.
events.CANOPY_ELDERS_LEDGER_OF_GIFTS.title: The Canopy Elder's Ledger of Gifts
events.CARAVAN_RIBAT_LEAVINGS.loss: {character} bled out on a coffer latch at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
events.CARAVAN_RIBAT_LEAVINGS.pages.INITIAL.des: A Forest Ranger patrol out of Caravan Ribat turned up two items scattered from a raided trade caravan, and neither carries a manifest tag to say who they belonged to. The ranger captain has no patience for a full inventory report over two loose objects; she holds them out, one in each hand, and waits for you to pick.

events.CHINJU_FOREST_PASSENGER.pages.INITIAL.de: Chinju Forest, an hour past the shrine. The straw hat that dropped onto your shoulders is not a hat — it has paws, and it is already whispering fox-lore and old sword forms into your ear like it has been waiting years for someone to hold still long enough. Your Sangonomiya scout mouths one word: tanuki. Do not insult it.

events.CONTRACT_RECITING_GROWTH.pages.INITIAL.d: At the Chasm's mouth, a Qixing survey crew has roped off a ley-line growth that fastened onto a miner before anyone could stop it. It hasn't let go, and it hasn't stopped reciting — old adeptal covenants, none of them Liyue law anymore, all of it delivered in a bored monotone against your ear the moment you get close. A diviner offers you the standing choice she's already offered three others today, terms unchanged: sit still and learn, or tear it off and take what it was holding.

events.COOKFIRE_FORGE.pages.INITIAL.description: At the cookfires of Mictlan, a Collective of Plenty smith has two worn practice blades and two dented practice bucklers laid on the anvil-stone, and no patience for carrying four mediocre things when the forge could make two good ones. "Every warrior in this camp bets on one pairing or the other," she says, banging her hammer flat for quiet. "Feed me your strikes, or feed me your guards — I only fold one kind at a time, and I fold it right." A Tatankasaur snorts approval from its stall, already used to being right about these things.

events.COOKFIRE_PITS.pages.INITIAL.description: The cookfire grounds at Mictlan are pocked with holes this season, each one sized exact to a person, rims smooth as a mold. Nobody dug them and nobody's found the bottom. The Collective's cooks have started betting on who fits which hole. "Get in," says the eldest, not looking up from the spit. "Or walk off and let two things go instead — your call, but the pot's already opened."

events.CORAL_MIRROR_RORRI_M_LARO_C_EH_T.pages.I: Merusea Village keeps one wall of grown coral that no diver touches without asking first — polished by the current into something that reflects a little wrong on purpose. A Melusine archivist keeps a ledger of every change it has ever made and reads you the relevant page before you get close, at some length, with diagrams. Touched carefully, she explains, the wall corrects two of your habits for the worse and four for the better. Broken outright, it keeps no favorites: it copies everything you are, all at once, and hands back a second you that carries its own bad luck. She will not choose for you, and she is sorry either way.
Duplicate your entire Deck. Add Bad Luck (curse) to your Deck.

events.CUT_ROPE_BRIDGE_ABOVE_CIDER_LAKE.pages.I: The rope bridge below Springvale sways badly enough that a Knights of Favonius patrol has roped off both ends and posted a warning plank. The duty Knight says regulation calls for a full unload before crossing — courtesy says she'll let you pick what goes over the rail first. events.DEFILEMENT_AT_SERPENTS_HEAD.pages.INITIA: Among the ribs of the fallen serpent on Yashiori Island, a scout's blade stands abandoned in the ash. Tatarigami residue has crept up the steel and moves along it like something drawing breath. A Sangonomiya field medic watches you notice it. "Defilement doesn't leave a thing," she says. "It only changes hands." She holds out a flint, and says nothing else.

events.DOCKS_SCRAP_MANIFEST.pages.INITIAL.descr: A scrap pile has grown against the Liyue Harbor breakwater for as long as the dockhands can remember, added to by every ship that doesn't want to pay the disposal fee. A Feiyun clerk pokes through it with a ledger stick, sorting what's worth logging from what isn't. "Dive in for whatever's still good underneath," she offers, "or just grab what's on top — it's all priced the same to the Guild, which is to say it isn't priced at all."

events.DRIFTING_LIGHT.pages.INITIAL.description: A stray light drifts loose over the Tepeacac Rise scree, guttering like it's lost its court. The Children of Echoes have a plain rule for such things, the same one they have for most of what the mountain keeps: bottle it and it answers you back, at a cost the tribe never pretends is free. Or leave it be and work the ground it's hovering over instead, where something older than the light has been sitting untouched.

events.DRILLMASTER_OF_WATATSUMI.pages.INITIAL.d: On the terraced stone above Sangonomiya Shrine, a drillmaster works a line of fishermen who were handed spears three weeks ago and have not slept properly since. She fought Fatui at Nazuchi Beach and came back with opinions. Her whole curriculum, she admits, is two motions — everything else is Watatsumi bravado. "Learn one properly," she says, "and I will not have to write your family."

A dockhand crew at Yaoguang Shoal has been hauling up pieces of a lighthouse nobody remembers building. Most of it is junk, but the lamp-glass came up whole, still faintly warm, still faintly glowing. The foreman states the terms flat: a bottle of what leaked out of it is yours for free, or you can go down after the lens itself and pay for it in altitude you won't get back. "Ledger's the same either way," he says. "Just different columns."
Lose 13 Max HP. Obtain Fresnel Lens (relic).

events.EAR_WHISPERER.pages.INITIAL.description: On the scree slopes of Tepeacac Rise, a Children of Echoes tracker finds you first — an old memory-leech has fastened behind your ear, feeding you fragments of something it half-remembers. "Let it finish the lesson," she says, "or I rip it clear myself." Either way you learn something today, she promises; the tribe just disagrees on the price. A Qucusaur circles overhead, unbothered, the way it always is when the Echoes start arguing about the past.
Lose 5 HP. Gain a companion (Colorless) card reward — two cards, following the gallery's own reading of the harvest's template-stripped "Colorless 2 card reward."

The Opera Epiclese is packed to the rafters, and the Oratrice Mecanique d'Analyse Cardinale hums cold above the dock. A gardes usher finds you in the aisle: a juror has fainted, and the Chief Justice will not open a docket a seat short. The Oratrice weighs the gallery's conviction — so tonight your opinion is evidence. The bailiff calls one case only. The Merchant's Case (Merchant Trial):
Sit on the jury. One case is called, and you deliver its verdict.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.MERCHANT: The defendant is a Fleuve Cendre smuggler in a Court-issued suit, accused of moving unlicensed potions through the Poisson canals. The Oratrice hums. The gallery waits on the empty seat.
Add Regret (curse) to your Deck. Obtain 2 random Relics.
Add Shame (curse) to your Deck. Upgrade 2 cards.
The Oratrice agrees with you. The smuggler's confiscated stock is offered to the jury first, and the verdict follows you out of the Opera as Regret.
The Oratrice disagrees. The gardes release the smuggler, and a clerk quietly notes the dissent beside your name: Shame. The Court pays its jurors in technique, not Mora.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.NOBLE.de: The defendant is a Palais Mermonia heir accused of paying a duel's loser to lose. The Oratrice hums. The gallery waits on the empty seat.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.NOBLE.op: Add Regret (curse) to your Deck. Gain 300 Gold.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.NOBLE_GU: The Oratrice agrees. The heir is fined, the gallery cheers, and a Melusine attendant presses a tonic into your hand on the way out.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.NOBLE_IN: The Oratrice disagrees, loudly. The heir's family thanks you with a very full purse, and you carry the verdict out as Regret.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.NONDESCR: The defendant gives no name, and the docket lists no crime beyond "obstruction of the Oratrice." The Oratrice hums. The gallery waits on the empty seat.
Add Doubt (curse) to your Deck. Gain 2 card rewards.
Add Doubt (curse) to your Deck. Transform 2 cards.
The Oratrice returns no reading at all. The nameless defendant is led away, the docket closes, and Doubt closes with it. The clerk hands you two files from the evidence table.
The Oratrice returns no reading at all. The nameless defendant walks, thanks you, and leaves you with Doubt and two techniques you no longer recognise as your own.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.REJECT.d: The usher's smile does not move. "The Chief Justice does not open a docket a seat short, and the doors do not open until the docket closes." Behind him the gardes have already turned to face the aisle.
events.EMPTY_SEAT_IN_THE_GALLERY.pages.REJECT.o: Sit on the jury. One case is called.

events.FEIYUN_SLOPE_SUPPER_BELT.pages.INITIAL.d: A Feiyun clerk has rigged a dumbwaiter belt to run dish after dish up from a kitchen nobody can see the bottom of, and posted the price plainly: forty Mora a plate, no refunds, no guarantee what's under the lid. "Guild takes no responsibility for what the belt serves," he recites, "only for what it's paid." Anyone with a full purse may keep grabbing as long as the belt keeps turning; anyone without one is asked, politely, to step aside.

events.FESTIVAL_BREW_STAND.pages.INITIAL.descri: At the festival grounds, a Flower-Feather brewer pours three cups and names her price for each before you've even sat down — that's the custom, she says, not a courtesy. Pay for the sharp one and your opening hand comes out honed. Pay more for the slow-burning one and you run hot for five whole bouts. Or take the free cup, which she pours for anyone, and warns you about first.

events.FLOODED_LEDGER_ROOM.pages.INITIAL.descri: Below the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, a records room kept every burial contract Liyue Harbor ever signed, until the last flood took the lower shelves. An archivist wades among the salvage with a bottle of ink that somehow never ran, and recites the terms without flinching: gain a little strength for free, or pay to have the ink itself steady a page — or two — against everything still trying to wash it away. The dead's contracts, she says, are never mocked here, only kept.

events.FOUND_THINGS_SHELF_MERUSEA_VILLAGE.pages: Merusea Village's hollow glows tide-blue and smells of kelp and candle wax. A Melusine keeps the village's shelf of found things, three of them set out on grown coral — one high, one at eye level, one down by her boots. Nothing here can be bought, she explains gravely; a thing without a story attached to it is only ballast. So you must leave a story behind to take one away.

Resistance scouts mark such lights on the map and walk past them; the Watatsumi shrine maidens hold that a flame which will not settle is a flame still carrying something. Below, the old slag fields are full of what the war left behind.

Past the mossed torii the forest floor is pocked with dens, each opening exactly the size of a person, the walls smooth as though someone had been poured in and let go politely. A tanuki sits at the nearest rim, counting on its claws. It will not tell you which den is yours to try; it only watches to see whether you'll trust the earth to give you back the shape you came in with.

She trades a flask for a drilled technique on the spot: better stock earns a better lesson, and she says so before you hand anything over. A fourth tray, marked with the resistance's own brewers' seal, and a fifth, a single cracked stone bottle nobody claims, sit apart from the rest.

events.FURINA_CURTAIN_CALL.pages.ASK_FOR_AN_ENC: They stay. Her heart is pounding. She sends the orchestra back to the top twice, because the tempo is wrong.
One proper bow, and off while they're still clapping. Someone in the wings is grinning at her.
events.FURINA_CURTAIN_CALL.pages.GIVE_THEM_THE_: Halfway through she changes the ending, because she has a better one. The orchestra, somehow, follows her.
events.FURINA_CURTAIN_CALL.pages.INITIAL.descri: The last stage. Every seat is full, and every face is someone she knew in Fontaine, or nearly. They have been waiting for her a long time.

Bow and leave them wanting more.

events.FURINA_EMPTY_HOUSE.pages.INITIAL.descrip: A theatre stands on this landing, impossibly: red velvet rows and not one seat taken. As Furina walks in, the stage lights come up, as if they had been waiting for her. She straightens before she can stop herself.
events.FURINA_EMPTY_HOUSE.pages.INITIAL.options: Take a costume from the rack.
events.FURINA_EMPTY_HOUSE.pages.PERFORM_FOR_NO_: She plays every part and finally lands the high note in the second act. Nobody claps. She bows anyway, and makes a note about the lighting.
events.FURINA_EMPTY_HOUSE.pages.SIT_IN_THE_FRON: She has never actually sat out here. The seats are softer than she thought. She stays until her feet stop aching.
It fits perfectly. She would very much like to know who took her measurements.

events.FURINA_EMPTY_THRONE.pages.BREAK_IT.descr: It shatters like a stage prop, because that's all this one is.
events.FURINA_EMPTY_THRONE.pages.INITIAL.descri: At the top of the stairs is a throne over still water: the one from the prophecy, where the Archon was to sit weeping after everyone else was gone. It is empty. A seat for one.

events.FURINA_EMPTY_THRONE.pages.WALK_PAST_IT.d: "No, thank you," she says, as if it had offered, and keeps climbing.

events.FURINA_LETTER_FROM_THE_COURT.pages.ORDER: She sends the courier off with the Mora and an order. On the next landing a box from Café Lutèce is waiting, still cold. She eats the whole thing on the stairs.
events.FURINA_LETTER_FROM_THE_COURT.pages.WRITE: Four pages: the stairs (too many), the lighting (dreadful), a very rude Ancient, and the cake situation, which she considers urgent. The courier tucks it away carefully.

events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.pages.GIVE_IT_A_PE: There is a slot for an admission fee. She pays, under protest, then gives it the old monologue from the top. It's still good. The machine hands back something new.
events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.pages.INITIAL.desc: A machine of brass and glass hangs over the landing, its scale swinging. It isn't the Oratrice. It only looks like it, the way a bad dream looks like a room you know. A plate reads: [i]State your case.[/i]
events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.pages.INITIAL.opti: Lose 12 HP. Gain a random relic.
events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.pages.INITIAL_HUMM:
The overture is stuck in her head.

events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.pages.PLEAD_GUILTY: "I lied to everyone for five hundred years." A pause. "And it kept them alive." The scale tips, and something drops into the tray.
events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.pages.PLEAD_INNOCE: "I did what I had to, and it worked." The scale doesn't move. "Well? Say something." It never could decide anything by itself.
events.FURINA_ORATRICES_ECHO.title: The Oratrice's Echo
events.FURINA_RISING_WATER.pages.HUM_THE_OVERTU: She hums all the way across, loudly. There are coins in the water, like at the Fountain of Lucine, and she takes a handful for luck. Her hands shake for an hour.
events.FURINA_RISING_WATER.pages.INITIAL.descri: Water is creeping up the stairs, ankle-deep and rising. Furina stops dead. For five hundred years she waited for exactly this, and smiled at everyone the whole time.
events.FURINA_RISING_WATER.pages.INITIAL.option: Hum the overture and wade on.
Stand in it until it stops.
events.FURINA_RISING_WATER.pages.RUN_FOR_THE_ST: She takes the stairs two at a time until they are dry and she can't breathe. Whatever she dropped on the way, she doesn't go back for it.
events.FURINA_RISING_WATER.pages.STAND_IN_IT.de: "It's over. It's been over for ages," she tells the water. It stops at her knees. She waits a long time anyway, to be sure.
events.FURINA_RISING_WATER.title: Rising Water
events.FURINA_STEAMBIRD_CLIPPING.pages.CAST_THE: Lead: Furina. Then a part for everyone she can think of. Charlotte gets a cameo, as a reporter, which serves her right.
events.FURINA_STEAMBIRD_CLIPPING.pages.FOLD_IT_: Folded along the old creases. She'll want it for the next person who doubts her.
An envelope is tucked under a stone on the landing, addressed in Charlotte's hand. Inside is a page of The Steambird, folded to the reviews, one circled in red: "Former Archon Steals the Show." In the margin: "Sequel when? And I'm still waiting on that interview! —C."
Cast the sequel in the margin.
events.FURINA_STEAMBIRD_CLIPPING.pages.READ_IT_: She does all the voices, Charlotte's included. On the second reading she adds the exclamation marks Charlotte left out.
events.FURINA_STEAMBIRD_CLIPPING.title: A Steambird Clipping

events.GRANDMOTHER_CORALIE_OF_MERUSEA_VILLAGE.p: Merusea Village hangs quiet in the blue below Fontaine, and the oldest Melusine there keeps a driftwood counter of everything the water has handed back. She has no use for any of it; she simply likes the ceremony of exchange, and the Marechaussee Phantom long ago stopped asking where her stock comes from. "A courtesy for a courtesy, monsieur adventurer."

events.GUEST_IN_THE_HULL.pages.INITIAL.descript: A Melusine dockhand at Romaritime Harbor waves you over to an overturned skiff with the delight of someone showing off a pet. Something soft and iridescent has taken up residence in the hull; it hums, and it has plainly been reading the salvage logs of everyone who touched it. "It gets lonely down there," she explains. "It only wants to come along with somebody." A lumidouce lantern hangs by the mooring post, already lit.

She offers you the chart itself, no questions asked, or a faster way out if the cliffs get the better of you.

"Relic's already loose in the rubble — free, take it," he says, "or you fight the both of them for the rest of what's buried under them. Millelith posted this as a hazard, not a commission, so nobody's paying you either way but them."

events.KETTLE_BELOW_SANGONOMIYA.pages.TEA_OF_DI: Drink what is left in the pot, unasked and unpaid. At the start of the next combat, shuffle 2 Dazed into your Draw Pile.
events.KETTLE_BELOW_SANGONOMIYA.title: The Kettle Below Sangonomiya
events.KLEE_ALICES_CACHE.pages.BACK_AWAY.descri: Klee tiptoes backwards all the way to the stairs. Dodoco keeps watch.
events.KLEE_ALICES_CACHE.pages.INITIAL.descript: At the end of Mom's marks is a little chest with a note: "For my darling Klee. Open in an emergency only! It's a bit lively, so stand back. And don't tell Jean. ♪" The chest is ticking.
Leave it for the next adventurer.
Lose 12 HP. Gain a random relic.
Lose 5 HP. Gain a random potion. Mom's chest will still be there.
Save it for a real emergency.
events.KLEE_ALICES_CACHE.pages.LEAVE_IT.descrip: Klee swaps in two of her own bombs, and some Mora for luck. Fair's fair.
events.KLEE_ALICES_CACHE.pages.OPEN_IT.descript: KABOOM. Mom wasn't joking about lively. Inside, wrapped in fireproof cloth, is something wonderful.
events.KLEE_ALICES_CACHE.pages.SAVE_IT.descript: The chest sputters at her the whole way up. Klee carries it very, very carefully.
events.KLEE_ALICES_CACHE.title: Alice's Cache
Klee trips twice and lands on somebody's lost treasure. The thief gets away, but Klee knows which way it went.
events.KLEE_DODOCO_GOES_MISSING.pages.INITIAL.d: Klee wakes up from a nap on the landing. Her backpack is open, and Dodoco is gone. Small sticky footprints lead away up the stairs, past a trail of Klee's snack crumbs.
events.KLEE_DODOCO_GOES_MISSING.pages.INITIAL.o: Lose 10 HP. Gain a random relic.
Wait here in case Dodoco comes back.
events.KLEE_DODOCO_GOES_MISSING.pages.LEAVE_MOR: By morning the Mora is gone, and so is a bit of junk from her bag. The sticky footprints go up.
events.KLEE_DODOCO_GOES_MISSING.pages.WAIT_HERE: Klee waits and waits. Dodoco doesn't come back. She worries all the way up.
events.KLEE_DODOCO_GOES_MISSING.title: Dodoco Goes Missing
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.ASK_NICELY.descript: Klee trades it her last snack. Dodoco is a little sticky, but fine.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.GRAB_AND_RUN.descri: It bites. Klee doesn't let go of either.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL.description: The sticky footprints end at a nest of stolen things: buttons, a boot, half a sandwich. On top sits Dodoco. A small round creature with far too many eyes is hugging it.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL.options.ASK: Choose 1 of 3 random Uncommon Attacks to add to your deck. Remove every [gold]Doubt[/gold].
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL.options.GRA: Lose 11 HP. Gain a random relic. Remove every [gold]Doubt[/gold].
Grab Dodoco and some treasure, and run!
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL.options.SWA: Swap her best bomb for Dodoco.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL_BAIT.descri:
Klee's Mora is in the nest too.

The sticky footprints end at a nest of stolen things: buttons, a boot, half a sandwich. On top sits Dodoco. A small round creature with far too many eyes is hugging it.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL_CHASED.desc:
Klee knows this trail. She ran most of it.

The sticky footprints end at a nest of stolen things: buttons, a boot, half a sandwich. On top sits Dodoco. A small round creature with far too many eyes is hugging it.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.pages.INITIAL_WAITED.desc:
Klee has been worried the whole way up.

The sticky footprints end at a nest of stolen things: buttons, a boot, half a sandwich. On top sits Dodoco. A small round creature with far too many eyes is hugging it.
It gives her a rock in return. Klee keeps the rock.
events.KLEE_FOUND_YOU.title: Found You!
events.KLEE_KNIGHTS_COME_LOOKING.pages.ALBEDO.d:
Albedo: "I'm glad you're safe. Show me where you're going, and we'll find a way up."
Klee: "You found me! Can we see what's at the top before we go home? Please?"
events.KLEE_KNIGHTS_COME_LOOKING.pages.EVERYONE: Klee: "You can all come! Dodoco, make room!" The three fall in behind her, trying very hard to look like they were planning to anyway.
Klee hears her name from the stairs below. Kaeya spots her first and waves. Noelle hurries up beside him, and Albedo lets out a quiet sigh of relief.
Lose 12 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Rare Companions to add to your deck.
Lose 6 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Uncommon Companions to add to your deck.
Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Common Companions to add to your deck.
events.KLEE_KNIGHTS_COME_LOOKING.pages.INITIAL_:
A knight holds out something small and a little sticky. "Found this on the stairs below. Is it yours?" It's Dodoco.

Klee hears her name from the stairs below. Kaeya spots her first and waves. Noelle hurries up beside him, and Albedo lets out a quiet sigh of relief.

Dodoco rides on Klee's shoulder the whole way.

Klee hears her name from the stairs below. Kaeya spots her first and waves. Noelle hurries up beside him, and Albedo lets out a quiet sigh of relief.
events.KLEE_KNIGHTS_COME_LOOKING.pages.KAEYA.de:
Kaeya: "There you are! Shall we finish your adventure together? Jean's waiting for us."
Klee: "You found me! Can we see what's at the top before we go home? Please?"
events.KLEE_KNIGHTS_COME_LOOKING.pages.NOELLE.d:
Noelle: "Are you hurt, Klee? Here, have something to eat. I'll stay with you."
Klee: "You found me! Can we see what's at the top before we go home? Please?"
events.KLEE_KNIGHTS_COME_LOOKING.title: The Knights Come Looking
events.KLEE_LETTER_FROM_JEAN.pages.INITIAL.desc:
A Favonius pigeon lands on Klee's backpack with a letter tied to its leg. It is in Jean's handwriting.

[i]"Klee — Albedo told me where you went. We are coming to find you. Until then, stay with your friends and remember to eat. Keep your bombs away from the stairs and pillars. I want you home safely. — Jean, Acting Grand Master"[/i]
events.KLEE_LETTER_FROM_JEAN.pages.INITIAL.opti: Upgrade 2 random cards that place a Bomb.
Fold it into a paper bomb.
Remove a Curse from your deck. If you have none, gain 50 Gold.
events.KLEE_LETTER_FROM_JEAN.pages.PAPER_BOMB.d: It folds into a perfect little bomb. Jean won't mind. Probably.
events.KLEE_LETTER_FROM_JEAN.pages.READ_IT_TWIC: Klee reads it twice, then a third time. She tucks it in next to Dodoco.
events.KLEE_LETTER_FROM_JEAN.pages.WRITE_BACK.d: Dear Jean, I will be good. Mostly. Love, Klee.
events.KLEE_LETTER_FROM_JEAN.title: A Letter from Jean
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.FOLD_INTO_A_FU: The ink burns blue. Klee saves a scrap for later.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.INITIAL.descri: Pinned to the last landing with a tiny bomb-shaped pin is one more note in Mom's handwriting.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.INITIAL.option: Upgrade 3 random cards that place a Bomb.
Fold the note into a fuse.
Read it out loud to Dodoco.
Lose 10 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Rare cards to add to your deck.
Try the trick on the back.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.INITIAL_LEFT.d:
"You left it for someone else? You're kinder than I ever was. ♪"

Pinned to the last landing with a tiny bomb-shaped pin is one more note in Mom's handwriting.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.INITIAL_NO_CAC:
"I knew you'd make it this far."

Pinned to the last landing with a tiny bomb-shaped pin is one more note in Mom's handwriting.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.INITIAL_OPENED:
"You opened it, didn't you? Of course you did. Was it a real emergency? (It always is.)"

Pinned to the last landing with a tiny bomb-shaped pin is one more note in Mom's handwriting.
"You didn't open it? My sensible little spark! Go on, open it now. You've earned it."

Pinned to the last landing with a tiny bomb-shaped pin is one more note in Mom's handwriting.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.OPEN_THE_CHEST: Klee sets the chest down and opens it at arm's length, just like Mom said.
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.pages.READ_IT_OUT_LO: "...and I'll see you in Mondstadt. Love, Mom." Klee reads it twice.
On the fifth try, it works. "I did it, Dodoco! Let's do it again!"
events.KLEE_MOMS_LAST_NOTE.title: Mom's Last Note
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.pages.ADD_A_MARK.descrip: A bomb, a star, and "Klee was here too!"
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.pages.FOLLOW_THE_MARKS.d: The marks lead to a little pouch of Mora. Mom always leaves snack money.
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: Scratched into a pillar, at exactly Klee's height: a little bomb, a star, and "Alice was here! ♪". More marks lead upward, and beside them a recipe.
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.pages.INITIAL.options.AD: Add a mark of her own.
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.pages.INITIAL.options.TR: Lose 10 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random Rare cards to add to your deck.
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.pages.TRY_THE_RECIPE.des: It works! Klee's eyebrows will grow back.
events.KLEE_MOMS_MARKS.title: Mom's Marks

events.KLEE_STARSNATCH_CLIFF.pages.BLAST_THE_PO: KABOOM! Fish everywhere. Klee hopes the Spire doesn't tell Jean.
events.KLEE_STARSNATCH_CLIFF.pages.INITIAL.desc: A still pool in the Spire's stone is full of fat, silver fish. It looks just like the pond below Starsnatch Cliff, back home. Klee has three bombs left and nobody is watching. She remembers Jean's face the last time.
events.KLEE_STARSNATCH_CLIFF.pages.INITIAL.opti: Gain 75 Gold. Add [gold]Confinement[/gold] to your deck.
Choose 1 of 3 random Common Attacks to add to your deck.
Remove a card from your deck.
events.KLEE_STARSNATCH_CLIFF.pages.JUST_ONE_LIT: Just a little one. Klee keeps the biggest fish for Dodoco.
events.KLEE_STARSNATCH_CLIFF.pages.LEAVE_THEM_B: Klee puts the fuse away and watches the fish swim past.
events.KLEE_STARSNATCH_CLIFF.title: Starsnatch Cliff
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.pages.INITIAL.descrip: Pale coral glows in a crack in the stone, the color of the reefs off Watatsumi. On afternoons the shrine let her keep for herself, she used to swim out to coral like this and stay until someone came looking.
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.pages.INITIAL.options: Lose 10 HP. Gain a random relic.
Kneel at the water and pray.
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.pages.LEAVE_A_PEARL.d: On Watatsumi you pay the sea back. She picks her best pearl.
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.pages.LEAVE_IT.descri: She watches it glow for a while, then climbs on.
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.pages.REACH_IN.descri: The coral cuts, as coral does. She would have done it at ten as well.
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.pages.SAY_THE_SEA_PRA: The water is cold to the knee. She says the old island words softly, as fishing families say them before a voyage.
events.KOKOMI_CORAL_LIGHT.title: Coral Light
events.KOKOMI_EMPTY_ROOM.pages.INITIAL.descript: Behind a door with nothing written on it is a small room: one cushion, one lamp, a stack of unread books. Kokomi closes the door behind her. For the first time since the Spire began, nobody needs her to decide anything.
Choose 1 of 3 random Uncommon Powers to add to your deck.
events.KOKOMI_EMPTY_ROOM.pages.PLAN_A_HOLIDAY.d: Three days off, two fallbacks, one beach. She files it under [i]urgent[/i].
events.KOKOMI_EMPTY_ROOM.pages.READ_THE_TOP_BOO: A treatise on naval supply. On page forty the author is wrong about tides, and she fills three margins explaining why.
events.KOKOMI_EMPTY_ROOM.pages.TAKE_AN_HOUR.des: She does nothing at all, carefully, for a whole hour.
events.KOKOMI_EMPTY_ROOM.title: A Room with No One In It
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.BOW_AND_WALK_PAST.d: A commander's bow, one to another. She takes the stairs, and it does not follow.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.INITIAL.description: The faceless commander waits at the top of the stairs without its board. It has one piece left. So does she. The step between them is split down the middle, like the fold in a game board.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.INITIAL.options.OFF: Lose 18 HP. Gain a random Rare relic.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.INITIAL.options.PAY: Pay its stake and trade pieces.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.INITIAL_CONCEDED.de:
She knows its opening by heart now.

The faceless commander waits at the top of the stairs without its board. It has one piece left. So does she. The step between them is split down the middle, like the fold in a game board.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.INITIAL_DREW.descri:
Their game is still unfinished.

The faceless commander waits at the top of the stairs without its board. It has one piece left. So does she. The step between them is split down the middle, like the fold in a game board.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.INITIAL_PLAYED.desc:
She beat it once, by a single piece.

The faceless commander waits at the top of the stairs without its board. It has one piece left. So does she. The step between them is split down the middle, like the fold in a game board.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.OFFER_HER_LAST_PIEC: She sets her piece on the split step. It takes the piece, as it always does, and the stair folds shut over it like a closing board. The jolt throws her hard against the wall.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.pages.PAY_ITS_STAKE.descr: It will not trade for nothing. She counts out its stake in Mora, and they trade their last pieces.
events.KOKOMI_ENDGAME.title: Endgame
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.CONCEDE.des: She plays its first ten moves against herself until she sees it: it takes every piece left in reach.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.INITIAL.des: Across another sand table sits a figure in grey with no face, its pieces in a patient line. It opens a hand: your move.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.INITIAL.opt: Add [gold]Doubt[/gold]. Choose 1 of 3 random Rare cards.
Lose 12 HP. Gain a random relic.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.INITIAL_MOV:
Her piece is already here. She did not move it this far.

Across another sand table sits a figure in grey with no face, its pieces in a patient line. It opens a hand: your move.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.INITIAL_PLA:
She knows this floor. She has already lost on it twice, in sand.

Across another sand table sits a figure in grey with no face, its pieces in a patient line. It opens a hand: your move.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.INITIAL_POC:
The general in her pocket has gone warm.

Across another sand table sits a figure in grey with no face, its pieces in a patient line. It opens a hand: your move.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.OFFER_A_DRA: It agrees only once she offers it a piece to keep. It cannot leave a piece on the table.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.pages.PLAY_THE_FU: It takes every piece she offers, even the bad ones. She wins by one piece, hours later.
events.KOKOMI_OTHER_COMMANDER.title: The Other Commander
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.pages.EAT_THE_S: Bird egg sushi, her favorite. Gorou remembered. She eats every piece and sends the box back with a thank-you.
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.pages.INITIAL.d: A Watatsumi scout is waiting on the stair, soaked to the knee, with a satchel and a wrapped box. "From the General, Your Excellency. He said to wait for your answer." The letter reads: "Drills on schedule. Fishing boats out. Bourou Village sends sushi. Requesting permission to send reinforcements. —Gorou. P.S. Please eat properly."
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.pages.INITIAL.o: Eat the sushi while it is fresh.
Choose 1 of 3 random Uncommon Companions to add to your deck.
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.pages.INITIAL_R:
Rested, she reads it twice.

A Watatsumi scout is waiting on the stair, soaked to the knee, with a satchel and a wrapped box. "From the General, Your Excellency. He said to wait for your answer." The letter reads: "Drills on schedule. Fishing boats out. Bourou Village sends sushi. Requesting permission to send reinforcements. —Gorou. P.S. Please eat properly."
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.pages.SEND_FOR_: The scout runs down the stairs with her orders. An hour later there are paw prints on the landing and a familiar voice calling drill.
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.pages.WRITE_BAC: Three pages of orders, and a fourth telling him to rest too. The scout salutes and goes.
events.KOKOMI_REPORT_FROM_GOROU.title: A Report from Gorou
events.KOKOMI_SAND_TABLE.pages.INITIAL.descript: A low table on the landing holds a sand map of the Spire, floor by floor, with a carved piece for everything that lives here. One piece is a little jellyfish. It is standing exactly where Kokomi is standing.
Move her piece up one floor.
Play it out until the candles go out.
events.KOKOMI_SAND_TABLE.pages.MOVE_HER_PIECE.d: She moves it gently, as if it might be watching. Something in her pack feels lighter.
events.KOKOMI_SAND_TABLE.pages.PLAY_IT_OUT.desc: She plays the next three floors four different ways and loses twice. By the end the candles are stubs, and she is smiling.
events.KOKOMI_SAND_TABLE.pages.POCKET_THE_GENER: It is a very small piece, and nobody said she couldn't.
events.KOKOMI_SAND_TABLE.title: The Sand Table
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.GATHER_THE_O: Someone has been leaving Mora here for a very long time. She takes it home for the shrine's poor box. The bone whispers to her all the way up.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.INITIAL.desc: A great curved bone is set into the wall, long as a boat, faintly purple. Every child on Watatsumi knows that shape: Orobashi, who brought his people up to the surface and later died fighting the Shogun. His remains have poisoned people before.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.INITIAL.opti: Gather the offerings at its foot.
Lose 8 Max HP. Gain a random relic.
Lay a hand on it, through her sleeve.
Promise him a rite at home.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.INITIAL_PAID:
She has one pearl left. She is glad she kept it.

A great curved bone is set into the wall, long as a boat, faintly purple. Every child on Watatsumi knows that shape: Orobashi, who brought his people up to the surface and later died fighting the Shogun. His remains have poisoned people before.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.INITIAL_PRAY:
The sea prayer is still in her mouth.

A great curved bone is set into the wall, long as a boat, faintly purple. Every child on Watatsumi knows that shape: Orobashi, who brought his people up to the surface and later died fighting the Shogun. His remains have poisoned people before.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.INITIAL_REAC:
Her palm still stings where the coral cut it.

A great curved bone is set into the wall, long as a boat, faintly purple. Every child on Watatsumi knows that shape: Orobashi, who brought his people up to the surface and later died fighting the Shogun. His remains have poisoned people before.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.LAY_A_HAND.d: She wraps her hand first and keeps the touch short; she knows what his remains did to Inazuma. For a moment she can feel the island he gave her people. The cold stays in her fingers.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.pages.PROMISE_A_RI: A proper one, on Watatsumi, with the whole shrine there. She means every word, and she is already dreading the speech.
events.KOKOMI_SERPENTS_BONES.title: The Serpent's Bones
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.INITIAL.descr: Water rises up the stairs: real sea water, salt and cold. Kokomi feels the same pull she uses to shape her Bake-Kurage, and the water answers her.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.INITIAL.optio: Send the water home to the sea.
Lose 6 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Uncommon Powers to add to your deck.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.INITIAL_BONES:
The water smells of salt and incense, like the shrine on festival days.

Water rises up the stairs: real sea water, salt and cold. Kokomi feels the same pull she uses to shape her Bake-Kurage, and the water answers her.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.INITIAL_OTHER:
The water moves when she does.

Water rises up the stairs: real sea water, salt and cold. Kokomi feels the same pull she uses to shape her Bake-Kurage, and the water answers her.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.INITIAL_REINF:
Somewhere below, she can hear Gorou's soldiers singing.

Water rises up the stairs: real sea water, salt and cold. Kokomi feels the same pull she uses to shape her Bake-Kurage, and the water answers her.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.RIDE_THE_TIDE: She lets the water carry her a floor and a half, eyes closed, like floating off the reef at home.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.SEND_THE_WATE: She sends it down toward the sea, with a message folded into the current for whoever on Watatsumi is listening.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.pages.SHAPE_A_SHOAL: A dozen Bake-Kurage, more than she has ever held at once. The whole stairwell turns blue with their light.
events.KOKOMI_TIDE_COMES_IN.title: The Tide Comes In
events.KSHAHREWAR_PROVING_CAGE.pages.DEFEAT.des: The proctor's count runs out with the construct still on its feet. He marks the bout incomplete and unlocks nothing.
events.KSHAHREWAR_PROVING_CAGE.pages.INITIAL.de: In a fenced yard behind the Kshahrewar workshops below the Akademiya, mechanists have rigged a padded practice construct to a calibrated spring-drum, patched and re-patched past counting. A darshan proctor times every bout against a water-clock she refuses to slow down for anyone. "Three turns," she says, already resetting the gauge. "Higher tension, better data, better prize. The construct does not care how tired you are."
events.KSHAHREWAR_PROVING_CAGE.pages.INITIAL.op: Fight a 75 HP dummy. Procure 1 random Potion.
Fight a 150 HP dummy. Upgrade 2 random cards.
Fight a 300 HP dummy. Obtain a random Relic.
events.KSHAHREWAR_PROVING_CAGE.pages.VICTORY.de: The spring-drum winds down before the proctor's count does. He marks the bout complete and unlocks that setting's prize.
events.KSHAHREWAR_PROVING_CAGE.title: The Kshahrewar Proving Cage
Behind the Akademiya's confiscations depot in Sumeru City, a Kshahrewar clerk has racked three items seized from students' unauthorized projects on a tiered shelf — top, middle, bottom — each tagged and cross-filed. He will not sell; departmental policy, which he cites by filing number, permits only like-for-like exchange. "One of yours for one of the shelf's," he says. "Choose the tier. I do not choose for you."
events.KSHAHREWAR_SURPLUS_OFFICE.title: The Kshahrewar Surplus Office
events.KSHAHREWAR_WORKBENCH.pages.CHOOSE_CARD_T: The mechanist lays two frames on the bench. "One design per visitor. Pick the frame, then the rider that goes in it."
She opens the drawer beneath the chosen frame. Two riders fit it. "Choose. I will not tell you which one I would take."
Add a random card into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.
Whenever you play a card this turn, the enemy loses 6 HP.
At the end of combat, Upgrade a random card.
events.KSHAHREWAR_WORKBENCH.pages.DONE.descript: The Proving Draft comes off the bench warm. She logs it under your name and points you at the containment glass on your way out.
events.KSHAHREWAR_WORKBENCH.pages.INITIAL.descr: In a cluttered annex of the Kshahrewar darshan's fabrication hall in Sumeru City, a mechanist clears bench space and slides forward a half-built chassis. "One design per visitor, and please stand behind the containment glass," she says, already reaching for the parts bin. Two of three frames are laid out; two of three riders wait beside them. **Step 1: Choose a Frame** (two of the three offered at random)
events.KSHAHREWAR_WORKBENCH.pages.INITIAL.optio: Pick one of the two frames on the bench.
events.KSHAHREWAR_WORKBENCH.title: The Kshahrewar Workbench
events.LEDGER_OF_SUNKEN_NAMES.pages.ACCEPT.desc: Add Dissolution (Decay curse) to your Deck. Enchant a card that Exhausts with Soul's Power (this card loses Exhaust).
events.LEDGER_OF_SUNKEN_NAMES.pages.CONFRONT.de: Obtain Sunken Keepsake (Forgotten Soul relic): whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
events.LEDGER_OF_SUNKEN_NAMES.pages.INITIAL.des: Beneath Merusea Village, a Melusine tends a coral shelf of keepsakes left by people the Court of Fontaine never entered among the drowned. She has copied every name into a ledger nobody has ever asked to read. You may take one keepsake away with you, she says, or you may read a name aloud — though the primordial water still remembers how to take back what it made.
events.LEDGER_OF_SUNKEN_NAMES.pages.INITIAL.opt: Add Dissolution (Decay curse) to your Deck. Enchant a card that Exhausts with Soul's Power (this card loses Exhaust).
Obtain Sunken Keepsake (Forgotten Soul relic): whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
Obtain Sunken Keepsake (Forgotten Soul relic): whenever you Exhaust a card, deal 1 damage to a random enemy.
events.LEDGER_OF_SUNKEN_NAMES.title: The Ledger of Sunken Names
events.LOOM_SAGE_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.ARACHNI: Pay 250 Mora (Gold). Remove 2 cards from your Deck.
events.LOOM_SAGE_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.BREATHI: Pay 50 Mora (Gold). Add 2 Enlightenment to your Deck.
events.LOOM_SAGE_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.EMOTION: Pay 125 Mora (Gold). Remove 1 card from your Deck.
events.LOOM_SAGE_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.INITIAL: Deep in Chinju Forest, past the mossed-over fox statues, a silk-draped youkai keeps a loom she has never once been seen to leave. The villagers of Konda call her the Loom-Sage, and the eight lacquered needles that drift around her work like a second pair of hands. She does not haggle. The price of stillness is brushed onto a wooden tag hung from the warp threads.
Pay 250 Mora (Gold). Remove 2 cards from your Deck.
Pay 50 Mora (Gold). Add 2 Enlightenment to your Deck.
Pay 125 Mora (Gold). Remove 1 card from your Deck.
Pay 125 Mora (Gold). Remove 1 card from your Deck.
events.LOOM_SAGE_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.title: The Loom-Sage of Chinju Forest
events.MARKER_OFF_THE_RACETRACK.pages.INITIAL.d: A Night-Wind racer clipped a marker-lantern off its post mid-race and hasn't slowed down long enough to feel bad about it. Turn it back in at the circuit and the stewards pay the standing bounty, no questions. Or keep it — but whatever's been guarding that post is already climbing down to ask for it back, in the one language a guard post understands.
events.MARKER_OFF_THE_RACETRACK.pages.INITIAL.o: Enter combat against a Mysterious Knight for the Lantern Key card.
events.MARKER_OFF_THE_RACETRACK.pages.KEEP_THE_: Enter combat against a Mysterious Knight for the Lantern Key card.

events.MELUSINES_PAMPHLET_OF_ENCOURAGEMENT.page: In Merusea Village a small Melusine in a rain hat presses a hand-stitched pamphlet on you, all pressed sumeru rose petals and enormous cheerful handwriting. She has been practising the speech that goes with it for some weeks. She will read you as much of it as you can bear, and takes no offence either way.

events.MEROPIDE_INFIRMARY_ROUNDS.pages.BIG_MUSH: Obtain Deepwater Draught (Big Mushroom relic). Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 20. At the start of each combat, draw 2 fewer cards.
events.MEROPIDE_INFIRMARY_ROUNDS.pages.FRAGRANT: Obtain Clarity Tincture (Fragrant Mushroom relic). Upon pickup, lose 15 HP and Upgrade 3 random cards.
Down in the Fortress of Meropide, a Melusine nurse pulls a curtain around your cot and sets two vials on the tray with great ceremony. One is cloudy and thick, brewed from Fontemer kelp to "make you bigger, and slower to wake." The other is clear and stings the eyes from across the room; she assures you it sharpens everything a person already knows how to do. Both are, regrettably, non-refundable.
Obtain Deepwater Draught (Big Mushroom relic). Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by 20. At the start of each combat, draw 2 fewer cards.

events.MICTLAN_RIG.pages.DONE.description: The rig chews through the bottle, clicks twice, and hands back the technique on a strip of scorched hide. The trader is already reaching for your belt again.
events.MICTLAN_RIG.pages.INITIAL.description: A Collective trader at Mictlan has built a rig that reads a concoction for the technique hidden in it, rather than just drinking it down like everyone else does. Only the first three bottles on your belt fit the rig, leftmost first — she's not sorting your pack for you. Whatever you feed it, you walk away better armed than you walked in, upgraded to match what the bottle was worth.

events.MICTLAN_TALLY_STALL.pages.INITIAL.descri: At the busiest stall in Mictlan, a Collective trader keeps a running tally chalked on a hide behind the counter — every purchase you make here follows your name for good, she says plainly, same as every debt does. The bargain crate is cheap and quick. The featured piece is pricier and named up front, no surprises. The sealed box costs the most and pays out slow, after five bouts have come and gone. Walk off with nothing, and she'll still take a look at your gear on the way past.

events.MICTLAN_TRADE_CIRCLE.pages.INITIAL.descr: At the Mictlan trade-circle, a Collective broker has three things laid out on a woven mat — top, middle, bottom — and won't say what any of them are until you've already reached. "Half the fun's in not knowing," he says, "and I'm not explaining it. Point, and it's yours."
events.MICTLAN_TRADE_CIRCLE.title: The Mictlan Trade-Circle
events.MOSI_MOSI_AT_STORMBEARER_POINT.loss: {character} did not survive the shaman's mark at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
events.MOSI_MOSI_AT_STORMBEARER_POINT.pages.HUG: Lose 9 HP. Choose a card to Transform.
events.MOSI_MOSI_AT_STORMBEARER_POINT.pages.INI: Wind off Stormbearer Point has scoured a hilichurl camp down to stakes, a cauldron, and one enormous mask. A Guild scout chalked the rock nearby: NON-HOSTILE, DO NOT PROVOKE, THEY TRADE. The shaman stirs something violently blue, taps the cauldron twice, then taps its own chest — two prices, your pick.
Lose 9 HP. Choose a card to Transform.
events.MOSI_MOSI_AT_STORMBEARER_POINT.title: Mosi Mosi at Stormbearer Point
events.NAMELESS_UNDER_THE_CEDAR.loss: {character} did not survive the spirit's leaving at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
events.NAMELESS_UNDER_THE_CEDAR.pages.INITIAL.d: Mist pools under the great cedar of Chinju Forest, and something without a shrine is waiting inside it. The ofuda has peeled from the bark; the spirit behind it has forgotten its own name and would rather borrow a body than fade. It offers warmth for your wounds, if you will let it share your breath.
events.NAMELESS_UNDER_THE_CEDAR.pages.INITIAL.o: Heal 25 HP. Add Borrowed Shape (Metamorphosis) to your Deck — the spirit settles into you, closing your hurts, and thereafter insists on wearing your hands its own way.
Lose 9 HP. Remove 1 card from your Deck — it recoils through your ribs on the way out, and takes with it one technique you can no longer remember learning.
events.NAMELESS_UNDER_THE_CEDAR.pages.LET_IT_IN: Heal 25 HP. Add Borrowed Shape (Metamorphosis) to your Deck — the spirit settles into you, closing your hurts, and thereafter insists on wearing your hands its own way.
events.NAMELESS_UNDER_THE_CEDAR.pages.REJECTION: Lose 9 HP. Remove 1 card from your Deck — it recoils through your ribs on the way out, and takes with it one technique you can no longer remember learning.
