events.NESTED_ARRAY.pages.INITIAL.description: On the black sand under Serpent's Head, a severed limb of the Perpetual Mechanical Array is still humming after all these years. Crystalflies have made a nest of its open joints, drifting in and out of the leaking Electro like sparks that forgot to die. A Watatsumi salvager crouches beside it, counting the pulses under her breath before she'll let anyone closer.
events.NESTED_ARRAY.pages.INITIAL.options.TOUCH: Grip the Humming Core (Touch the Core)
events.NESTED_ARRAY.title: The Nested Array
events.NORTHLAND_BANKS_DROWNED_VAULT.pages.INIT: The Northland Bank's Liyue branch has one vault the tide claimed decades ago and never gave back, and a Feiyun clerk has been contracted to appraise whatever a diver brings up from it. The first chest is modest and clean. The second is heavier, and the clerk warns you — plainly, before you touch it — that the Bank's gold never leaves a debt unnamed. "Take the small chest and walk away clean," she says, "or take the large one and carry what comes with it."
Gain 303–363 Gold. Add Greed (curse) to Deck.
events.NORTHLAND_BANKS_DROWNED_VAULT.pages.SECO: Gain 303–363 Gold. Add Greed (curse) to Deck.
events.NORTHLAND_BANKS_DROWNED_VAULT.title: The Northland Bank's Drowned Vault
events.OLD_YOROZU_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.INITIA: Under a leaning torii on the road toward the Grand Narukami Shrine, a tanuki elder in a leaf hat has laid out a mat of curios: a cracked mask, a bell, things that hum faintly of Electro. He is far too polite to beg, and far too old to be refused. "Etiquette, traveler. One does not receive without first giving."
events.OLD_YOROZU_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.title: Old Yorozu of Chinju Forest
events.OVERSHOT_DROP.pages.INITIAL.description: A Night-Wind courier overshot her drop on the ridge above Tequemecan Valley and the satchel burst wide — three bottles of something rough and mostly spoiled, and underneath, sealed better, one bottle she was actually paid to carry. "Grab the cheap stuff by the handful," she calls down, already remounting, "or dig for the one that's worth the climb. I'm not waiting on your decision."
events.OVERSHOT_DROP.title: The Overshot Drop
events.PRESSURE_TRIAL_AT_THE_INSTITUTE.pages.DE: The water-clock runs dry with the meka still standing. The technician closes her ledger without writing anything, which is somehow worse.
events.PRESSURE_TRIAL_AT_THE_INSTITUTE.pages.IN: Beneath the Institute's glass roof, a Melusine technician in oversized overalls wheels out a padded clockwork meka on a rail. Her ledger is already open: every strike will be logged, and the water-clock beside her drains in three measured pours. "Set the pressure valve first," she chirps. "Higher pressure, better data, better prize. But the clock does not negotiate."
Fight a 75 HP dummy. Procure 1 random Potion.
Fight a 150 HP dummy. Upgrade 2 random cards.
Fight a 300 HP dummy. Obtain a random Relic.
events.PRESSURE_TRIAL_AT_THE_INSTITUTE.pages.VI: The water-clock is not yet empty when the meka's padding gives way. The technician closes her ledger and hands over what that valve was rated for.
events.PRESSURE_TRIAL_AT_THE_INSTITUTE.title: Pressure Trial at the Institute
events.PROTOTYPE_HOUR_AT_THE_INSTITUTE.pages.CH: The Melusine engineer sets two chassis on the bench and taps the blast glass. "One prototype per visitor. Chassis first, then the modification."
She slides open the drawer for that chassis. Two modifications fit it. "Pick one. Both are tested. Neither is safe."
Add a random card into your Hand. It's free to play this turn.

events.PROTOTYPE_HOUR_AT_THE_INSTITUTE.pages.DO: The Prototype comes off the bench ticking. She stamps the Institute's mark on it and waves you back behind the glass.

events.QINGCE_LARDER.pages.GORGE.description: Choose 2 of 8 random Common cards to add to your Deck. The eight jars offered are never duplicates.
events.QINGCE_LARDER.pages.INITIAL.description: A collapsed terrace wall below Qingce Village opens onto a root-cellar the Feiyun Commerce Guild never finished inventorying before the harvest season turned it over to the village instead. Jars of pickled radish and aged tofu line the shelves, each one labeled in a farmer's careful hand. Behind the last rack, something has been fermenting far longer than the others, and it smells like it knows you're there.
events.QINGCE_LARDER.pages.INITIAL.options.GORG: Choose 2 of 8 random Common cards to add to your Deck. The eight jars offered are never duplicates.

events.QUARTERMASTERS_SPLIT.pages.INITIAL.descr: On the Watatsumi terraces, a resistance quartermaster is dividing what came back from a raid on a Fatui shipment. Two items are off the manifest entirely, and she would rather hand one to a fighter than explain both to Her Excellency's clerks. She slides them both forward and steps back.
events.QUARTERMASTERS_SPLIT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Unissued Fatui kit, well made and fitted for nobody in particular — least of all you. It hangs wrong on every stance you know, and the quartermaster does not offer to adjust it. Add Clumsy (Clumsy) to your Deck. Obtain a random Relic.
The Fatui latched it against thieves; the wire inside takes a strip off your forearm before the lid comes free. Lose 6 HP. Gain 57 Mora.

events.RACING_CAMPS_WAGER.pages.INITIAL.descrip: At the racing camp above Tequemecan Valley, three Masters of the Night-Wind riders corner you between heats, each certain their mount-style is the only one worth learning. Three will get a word in before the starting horn; the rest already know you ride your own way. Each rider bets a full set on their color — one common trick, one solid one, and one they'll only show you if you lose.

In a cold observation cell high in the Akademiya, a lens of starfall glass hangs in a gimbal ring, its face ruled into eleven by eleven wards. The Rtawahist scholar explains that each reading burns the clouding away — one ward, or a three-by-three quarter — and that a horoscope half-read is no horoscope at all. Downstairs, Dori Sangemah Bay has already drafted a contract with one very small clause.

events.RTAWAHIST_TWINNING_GLASS.pages.INITIAL.d: In a cold observation loft above the House of Daena, a Rtawahist scholar keeps a pane of starfall glass that does not merely reflect — it corrects, showing the observer back sharpened in some ways and reversed in others. She has one working pane and one cracked spare. "Touch the true glass, and it edits generously," she says. "Break the spare, and everything you are gets a duplicate — including the parts that shouldn't have one."

events.SOUNDING_THE_BERYL_SHELF.pages.INITIAL.d: The Melusines of Merusea Village have gridded a sunken freight lot on the Beryl Region shelf: eleven squares by eleven of gray silt, cargo somewhere beneath it. A harbormistress in an oilskin cap explains the sounding charges — one clears a single square, or a three-by-three sweep — and warns that only crates bared completely can be winched up. The big one at the lot's heart is four squares across; three soundings will never strip it.

events.SPILLED_SATCHEL_AT_SUMERU_CITYS_GATE.pag: At the western gate of Sumeru City, an Amurta darshan courier has upended her satchel dodging the bell of a Matra checkpoint. Half her stock is common field-brews nobody at the Akademiya will miss; the other case still carries an uncommon-grade tincture sealed for a professor's private study, and she has not yet decided whether to report it lost.

events.SPRINGS_EIGHT_STRAND_WEAVER.pages.INITIA: At the Toyac Springs, a weaver works eight strands at once, and half her trade isn't cloth at all — it's people, and the bad habits she says are only knots a patient hand can work loose. Pay the least and she teaches your hands to move lighter. Pay more and she picks a single tangle out of you for good. Pay the most and she takes two.

events.SPRINGS_GRID.pages.INITIAL.description: At the Toyac Springs, a People of the Springs elder keeps a broad basin of still water ruled into an eleven-by-eleven grid of stones, each one hiding something under the silt. Clear a stone at a time, she says, or sweep a handful at once — either way you're paying for the clearing, not for what's under it. One custom you settle now; the other, she says, the springs settle after.

Wheels of Mondstadt cheese sit rack on rack, gold-rinded and humming with age, and the slip in your hand says only: inventory it. Behind the furthest rack, something older than the racks is sweating brine.

At the scarred rim of Stormterror's Lair, a shard of black wind-crystal is still humming with borrowed memory. Before the Knights' scouting patrol can rope it off, it fastens itself against your ear and starts reciting something that isn't quite draconic and isn't quite language. The duty Knight logs the incident and does not offer to help. "Regulations say I note the time. Courtesy says I warn you it bites on the way out."
You tear it free with a strip of ear. Lose 5 HP. Gain a Colorless 2 card reward — two loose companion (Colorless) cards salvaged from what it was still transmitting.
Stand still and let the lesson finish. Choose 1 of 5 random cards to add to your deck.

events.SWEEP_OR_STOMP.pages.INITIAL.description: Deep in the canopy of Coatepec Mountain, a Scions of the Canopy ranger has been thinning a swarm of biting beetles for three days straight and has worn her arm down to two moves. "Sweep or stomp," she says, tossing you the choice like a dare. "Learn one clean and you'll never fumble the other one in." A Yumkasaur chitters at her heel, already scorching the stragglers she missed.
events.SWEEP_OR_STOMP.title: Sweep or Stomp
events.TALES_OF_GUYUN_WERE_TRUE.pages.INITIAL.d: The drowned hall under Guyun Stone Forest was supposed to be a fisherman's tall tale, but the tide is out and the doorway is real stone. Treasure Hoarders reached it first and left in a hurry: overturned crates, a snuffed lantern, a lacquered chart pinned to the wall with a knife. Your Guild commission said survey only. The passage behind you is already taking water.
events.TALES_OF_GUYUN_WERE_TRUE.pages.INITIAL.o: Receive the Hoarders' spoils chart (Spoils Map).
Lose 8 HP scraping through the flooded crawlway. Procure 1 random Potion from a cracked Hoarder crate.
events.TALES_OF_GUYUN_WERE_TRUE.pages.NAB_THE_M: Receive the Hoarders' spoils chart (Spoils Map).
events.TALES_OF_GUYUN_WERE_TRUE.pages.SLOWLY_FI: Lose 8 HP scraping through the flooded crawlway. Procure 1 random Potion from a cracked Hoarder crate.
events.TALES_OF_GUYUN_WERE_TRUE.title: The Tales of Guyun Were True
events.TANUKI_STALL_ON_THE_SHRINE_ROAD.pages.IN: A tanuki has set up shop on a flat stone by the Grand Narukami Shrine road: three items on a lacquer tier, one high, one at eye level, one low. It will not name what any of them are, and it will not be hurried into explaining. Etiquette says a gift answers a gift; it folds its paws and waits for you to choose a shelf, not a price.
events.TANUKI_STALL_ON_THE_SHRINE_ROAD.title: The Tanuki Stall on the Shrine Road
events.THREE_DOSSIERS_BEFORE_SABZERUZ.pages.INI: The lamps of the House of Daena have burned down to their last oil. A Kshahrewar proctor drops three sealed dossiers on your desk: manuscripts accused of forged findings, all of which the sages want ruled on before the Sabzeruz festival crowds the halls. Akademiya custom hands the first ruling to the newest reader in the room. Only one author is awake to hear it. **The Trader's Treatise (Merchant Trial)**
Rule on one treatise. The proctor picks which.
Push the dossiers back across the desk.
events.THREE_DOSSIERS_BEFORE_SABZERUZ.pages.MER: The Trader's Treatise: a Port Ormos merchant's account of a rare ink, suspiciously profitable and suspiciously well cited. The proctor waits with the seal.
Add Regret (curse) to your Deck. Obtain 2 random Relics.
Add Shame (curse) to your Deck. Upgrade 2 cards.
Forged. The merchant's samples are seized, and the proctor lets you keep two of them. The seal you pressed is Regret.
Sound. The merchant sells his ink at a premium the next morning, and the proctor notes your leniency as Shame. Your fee is technique, refined.
events.THREE_DOSSIERS_BEFORE_SABZERUZ.pages.NOB: The Patron's Treatise: a rich patron's name on a paper his scribes plainly wrote, with a footnote that flatters a sage. The proctor waits with the seal.
Add Regret (curse) to your Deck. Gain 300 Gold.
Forged. The patron is struck from the roll, and the House stewards bring you tea and a bandage.
Sound. The patron's steward leaves a very heavy purse on the desk, and you carry the seal out as Regret.
events.THREE_DOSSIERS_BEFORE_SABZERUZ.pages.NON: The Unsigned Treatise: no author, no darshan, and findings nobody has managed to repeat or to disprove. The proctor waits with the seal.
Add Doubt (curse) to your Deck. Gain 2 card rewards.
Add Doubt (curse) to your Deck. Transform 2 cards.
Forged, you rule, and nobody can prove otherwise. The proctor files it under Doubt and hands you the next two manuscripts from the pile.
Sound, you rule, and nobody can prove otherwise. The proctor files it under Doubt, and two of your own notes come back to you rewritten.
events.THREE_DOSSIERS_BEFORE_SABZERUZ.pages.REJ: The proctor does not pick them up. "The sages assigned you this desk. Sabzeruz begins at dawn, and no one leaves the House of Daena with an open docket." The lamps gutter.
Open the dossiers. One treatise is put before you.
Leave the desk, the docket and the Akademiya behind. This ends the run.
events.THREE_DOSSIERS_BEFORE_SABZERUZ.title: Three Dossiers Before Sabzeruz
events.TICKING_RELIC.pages.INITIAL.description: Half-buried on the Tepeacac Rise scree, a machine older than any tribe's memory still ticks with something inside it — Night Kingdom make, the Children of Echoes say, plain as anything, the way they say most things that would scare another tribe silent. Study the ticking and it teaches you something with weight to it. Touch the core direct and it hands you something instant, no weight at all.
events.TICKING_RELIC.title: The Ticking Relic

events.TIDE_SCRYING_STONE_OF_YASHIORI.pages.INI: A slab of sea-worn stone on the Yashiori shoreline, said to show what the tide hasn't washed in yet. A resistance scout keeps watch over it with a sand-timer and a ledger of hits and misses. She will not divine on your behalf — she states the terms and steps back. Clear the stone's face a patch at a time, or by the handful, and whatever comes up whole is yours to take or leave, save the one reading nobody wants, which does not wait for you to choose.
events.TIDE_SCRYING_STONE_OF_YASHIORI.title: The Tide-Scrying Stone of Yashiori

Yaoguang Shoal keeps a run of mineral pools the diviners swear were dug by something older than Liyue's contracts. A robed attendant stands at the rail with a lacquered tally-board, terms already recited: the water gives, but it also takes, and it will keep taking for as long as you keep asking. "Every soak is priced the same," she says, "a little given back, a little owed." Behind her, someone still in the water has stopped counting how many times they've gone under.

Take one blind and trust the shelf. Or spend a little of yourself sorting through it, and trust your own eye instead.

Two shrine gates stand side by side on Mt. Tianheng's switchback trail, one lacquered gold, one lacquered black, and a diviner has set up a folding table between them like it's the most ordinary commission in the world. "Both gates are paid for," she says, tapping the ledger. "Light refines what you already carry. Dark takes something off your hands entirely. Choose the gate, not the philosophy — I only keep the tally." She does not recommend either.
events.TWIN_GATES_OF_MT_TIANHENG.title: The Twin Gates of Mt. Tianheng
events.TWO_GIFTS_FROM_THE_FONTEMER.loss: {character} bled out over a coin-purse at the [gold]{event}[/gold].
events.TWO_GIFTS_FROM_THE_FONTEMER.pages.INITIA: Beneath the roots of Elynas, Kiara has laid out the week's salvage on a flat stone, and two pieces have no owner listed in any Merusee ledger. She is delighted to give one away and firmly unwilling to give away both. She will not tell you which is the better find; she says that would spoil it.
Add Clumsy (curse) to your Deck. Obtain a random Relic.
events.TWO_GIFTS_FROM_THE_FONTEMER.pages.ORNATE: Add Clumsy (curse) to your Deck. Obtain a random Relic.
events.TWO_GIFTS_FROM_THE_FONTEMER.title: Two Gifts from the Fontemer

events.UNCLAIMED_CRATES.pages.INITIAL.descripti: Two crates turned up unclaimed after the last relay through Tequemecan Valley, and the Flower-Feather quartermaster running the prize table isn't in the mood to sort them. Pry the first and something in the latch bites back on the way to a fistful of coin. Or take the second, gear that's plainly worth more and plainly cursed to trip you on every third step — she'll let you decide which kind of trouble you'd rather carry.

events.UNCLAIMED_CRATES_AT_FEIYUN_SLOPE.pages.I: Two unlabeled crates sit on the Feiyun Slope loading dock, hauled off a cargo junk whose manifest never named them. A dockhand explains the Guild cannot log cargo it never contracted for, so the finder may claim exactly one. Whichever you take, the other is sealed and sent up to Liyue Harbor's lost-property office unopened, per the standing charter — no argument entered into the ledger either way.
Add Clumsy (curse) to your Deck. Obtain a random Relic.

events.UNDELIVERABLE_PARCELS.pages.INITIAL.desc: The aquabus to Merusea Village has stalled off the Beryl Region shallows, and its Melusine postmistress has laid the undeliverable parcels along the pier in tidy, apologetic rows. Most are returns from the Fontaine Research Institute — labels dissolved, contents entirely unrepentant. One box, set slightly apart, still smells of the Court of Fontaine's better apothecaries.
events.UNDELIVERABLE_PARCELS.pages.INITIAL.opti: Procure 1 random Court apothecary tonic (Uncommon Potion).

Pick your two and walk off happy, or dig past the racks for the one prize the clan swears is still down there, buried deep enough to cost you something getting to it.

Katheryne explains that the Guild cannot appraise cargo it never logged, so the finder may claim exactly one. Whichever you take, the other is sealed and sent to the vault unopened.
events.UNMARKED_CRATES.pages.INITIAL.options.OR: Inside, wrapped in oilcloth, is a piece of adventuring gear worth far more than the paperwork on it — and badly enough balanced that you keep catching your own boot on it. Add Clumsy (curse) to your Deck. Obtain a random Relic.

events.VARKA_ACTING_GRAND_MASTER.pages.CARRY_HE: He reads it on the way. It's mostly complaints about him.
Jean is waiting on the landing, alone, a ledger under her arm. "Five years, Grand Master. I came up to collect." She almost manages not to smile. Then, quieter: "The reports from the Spire stopped. I had to see for myself that you were all still standing."
Carry her ledger the rest of the way.
Lose 10 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Rare Companions to add to your deck.
Let her lead the last stretch.
Remove every Curse. Lose 50 Gold for each.
Promise a full report at Angel's Share.
events.VARKA_ACTING_GRAND_MASTER.pages.LET_HER_: "Lead on, Acting Grand Master." "Then keep up, Grand Master."
events.VARKA_ACTING_GRAND_MASTER.title: The Acting Grand Master
events.VARKA_DISPATCH_FROM_MONDSTADT.pages.INIT: A Favonius courier catches up with Varka on the stairs, out of breath, a satchel of reports under one arm. "From the Acting Grand Master, sir. She says you'll know which ones."
Choose 1 of 3 random Uncommon Companions to add to your deck.
Stop to sign every one of them.
Gain 75 Gold. Add [gold]Overdue Reports[/gold] to your deck.
events.VARKA_DISPATCH_FROM_MONDSTADT.pages.REQU: "And not the new recruits. Send the ones who complain. They're usually right."
events.VARKA_DISPATCH_FROM_MONDSTADT.pages.SIGN: He signs them against the wall, one after another. The courier has never seen him read a report so carefully.
"Tell her they're in good hands." He tucks the satchel under his cloak.
events.VARKA_DISPATCH_FROM_MONDSTADT.title: Dispatch from Mondstadt
events.VARKA_FIRST_EXAM.pages.DO_IT_PROPERLY.de: One at a time, by the book. Valentine would laugh at him.
events.VARKA_FIRST_EXAM.pages.INITIAL.descripti: Training dummies stand in a ring on this landing, as if someone set up a knight's exam inside the Spire. Varka cracks his knuckles. He has taken this exam before.
events.VARKA_FIRST_EXAM.pages.INITIAL.options.K: Lose 8 HP. Add an upgraded [gold]Four Winds' Ascension[/gold].
events.VARKA_FIRST_EXAM.pages.KNOCK_THEM_ALL_DO: Every dummy down in one pass. Nobody here to reject him.
events.VARKA_FIRST_EXAM.pages.WALK_PAST.descrip: He pats the nearest dummy on the way by.
events.VARKA_FIRST_EXAM.title: The First Exam
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.DILUC.descript:
Diluc: "There's a bottle at Angel's Share with your name on it. You're paying."
Varka: "Tell them to bring up the good bottle. The one you hide."
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.EULA.descripti:
Eula: "You still owe me a rematch. Don't you dare go easy."
Varka: "Tomorrow. After I've slept. I won't go easy."
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.INITIAL.descri: Favonius banners come into view on the stairs below. His expedition has caught up, with familiar faces from Mondstadt among them. After five years away, Varka has quite a welcome waiting. Jean folds her arms. "You owe me five years of reports, Grand Master." Eula, Noelle, and Diluc step forward.
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.INITIAL.option: Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Uncommon Powers to add to your deck.
Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Uncommon Attacks to add to your deck.
Choose 1 of 3 random upgraded Uncommon Skills to add to your deck.
Wave them back to the column.
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.INITIAL_SENT_D:
Halfway home, three knights climb back up to meet him. "Message delivered, sir. Jean says hurry up."

Favonius banners come into view on the stairs below. His expedition has caught up, with familiar faces from Mondstadt among them. After five years away, Varka has quite a welcome waiting. Jean folds her arms. "You owe me five years of reports, Grand Master." Eula, Noelle, and Diluc step forward.
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.INITIAL_SUPPLI:
The three from the rearguard are waiting at the top of the stairs, fed and rested. They saved him a loaf.

Favonius banners come into view on the stairs below. His expedition has caught up, with familiar faces from Mondstadt among them. After five years away, Varka has quite a welcome waiting. Jean folds her arms. "You owe me five years of reports, Grand Master." Eula, Noelle, and Diluc step forward.
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.INITIAL_TOOK_T:
The three from the rearguard march at the front of the column, grinning.

Favonius banners come into view on the stairs below. His expedition has caught up, with familiar faces from Mondstadt among them. After five years away, Varka has quite a welcome waiting. Jean folds her arms. "You owe me five years of reports, Grand Master." Eula, Noelle, and Diluc step forward.
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.NOELLE.descrip:
Noelle: "Welcome back, Grand Master! Please, let me take the front line."
Varka: "It's yours. I'll be right behind you."
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.pages.WAVE_THEM_BACK: Varka: "Stay with the others. I'll meet you all at the foot of the stairs."
events.VARKA_LONG_WAY_HOME.title: The Long Way Home
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: Three Favonius knights sit against the wall of the landing, bandaged and grey with dust. They straighten when they see him. "Grand Master. We fell behind. We can still fight, sir."
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.pages.INITIAL.options.SE: Send them down with a message.
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.pages.INITIAL.options.TA: Lose 10 HP. Choose 1 of 3 random Rare cards to add to your deck.
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.pages.LEAVE_SUPPLIES.des: He leaves his own pack and travels light. "Eat. That's an order."
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.pages.SEND_THEM_DOWN.des: "Tell Jean we're fine." They press their potions on him, and their paperwork.
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.pages.TAKE_THE_REAR.desc: "You lot walk in front. I'll keep the stairs behind us."
events.VARKA_REARGUARD.title: The Rearguard
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.HAND_TO_THE_C: "Consider it a promotion. And a raise."
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.INITIAL.descr: Another courier, another satchel, heavier than the first. "The Acting Grand Master says these are the urgent ones, sir. She underlined [i]urgent[/i]."
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.INITIAL.optio: Lose 8 HP. Upgrade 2 random cards. Remove every [gold]Overdue Reports[/gold].
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.INITIAL_LATER:
"Your overdue reports are now very overdue."

Another courier, another satchel, heavier than the first. "The Acting Grand Master says these are the urgent ones, sir. She underlined [i]urgent[/i]."
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.INITIAL_REINF:
"The reinforcements came with forms."

Another courier, another satchel, heavier than the first. "The Acting Grand Master says these are the urgent ones, sir. She underlined [i]urgent[/i]."
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.INITIAL_SIGNE:
"You signed the last lot so fast, sir, she sent twice as many."

Another courier, another satchel, heavier than the first. "The Acting Grand Master says these are the urgent ones, sir. She underlined [i]urgent[/i]."
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.LOSE_THEM_ON_: He keeps the satchel. It had snacks in it.
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.pages.SIGN_BY_LAMPL: He signs the last page at dawn, then goes back and reads the casualty lists twice.
events.VARKA_SECOND_SATCHEL.title: The Second Satchel
events.VARKA_SONG_ON_THE_WIND.pages.HUM_ALONG.d: He gets the second verse wrong. He always does.
events.VARKA_SONG_ON_THE_WIND.pages.INITIAL.des: The wind on this landing carries an old Mondstadt tune: a young man knocks out every examiner, is rejected anyway, then ambushes the Grand Master on his way home from the tavern to make a point. Varka knows the song. He was the young man.
events.VARKA_SONG_ON_THE_WIND.pages.REMEMBER_VA: "Find a reason of your own." He did, eventually. It was home.
events.VARKA_SONG_ON_THE_WIND.pages.TOAST_ABSEN: He raises a cup of the good wine to Valentine.
events.VARKA_SONG_ON_THE_WIND.title: A Song on the Wind
events.VARKA_WOLF_OF_THE_NORTH.pages.ASK_AFTER_: Boreas shows him Razor running with the wolves, fast and grinning. Varka watches until it fades.
events.VARKA_WOLF_OF_THE_NORTH.pages.INITIAL.de:
Frost spreads across the landing. Andrius takes shape beside Varka, stretches, and bares his teeth. The Wolf of the North gave him his title, and Varka knows that look well enough: his old partner wants a spar.

[i]"You've gone soft, Knight."[/i] — [i]"Soft? Come over here and say that."[/i]
events.VARKA_WOLF_OF_THE_NORTH.pages.INITIAL.op: Choose 1 of 3 random Uncommon Attacks to add to your deck.
events.VARKA_WOLF_OF_THE_NORTH.pages.REST.descr: He sleeps with his back against the wolf's flank, the way he did on the northern watch.
events.VARKA_WOLF_OF_THE_NORTH.pages.SPAR.descr: They wreck half the landing. Boreas looks pleased with himself.
events.VARKA_WOLF_OF_THE_NORTH.title: The Wolf of the North
events.WANDERING_CASK.pages.INITIAL.description: In the cellars beneath Dawn Winery, a Knights of Favonius quartermaster shows you a cask mislabeled two harvests ago. Whatever grew inside is no longer Dandelion Wine; the vintner is delighted, and the Knight very much is not. "Broach it and see what it became," the vintner offers. The quartermaster taps the ledger instead: "Or we do it properly, to the notes as written."

events.WANDERING_CASK.pages.INITIAL.options.MAI: Upgrade a card in your Deck.

events.WANDERING_CASK.title: The Wandering Cask
events.WAR_COUNCIL_AT_SANGONOMIYA.pages.INITIAL: Below the shrine, five division commanders have laid their banners over the map table and are arguing doctrine, each certain her unit's drill is the one that wins Watatsumi back. Three will get a hearing before the tide-drum calls the room to order, and none pitches the style you already carry. Each commander offers her technique in three grades — a common form, an uncommon one, and the drill she saves for veterans.
events.WAR_COUNCIL_AT_SANGONOMIYA.title: The War Council at Sangonomiya

Lose Lantern Key. Procure 2 random Potions. Obtain 2 random Relics.
events.WAR_HISTORIAN_RAPIYA.pages.INITIAL.descr: Deep beneath Ardravi Valley, the Akademiya buries what it would rather not teach. In a forgotten Matra holding-cell sits Rapiya, a Haravatat war-historian condemned for reading the Archon War the wrong way — and beside her cage stands the Matra's confiscation strongbox, still sealed. Your Lantern Key turns once, and only once.

events.WAR_HISTORIAN_RAPIYA.title: War Historian, Rapiya
events.WATATSUMI_DRILL_PRIMER.pages.INITIAL.des: A field manual with no cover left, passed down the Watatsumi line since before the Vision Hunt Decree. Every margin carries a dead soldier's handwriting — a grip correction, a stance fix, one line struck through and rewritten twice. The drill sergeant who hands it to new recruits below Sangonomiya Shrine does not recommend a page. She says only that the book teaches whatever the reader still has left to learn, and closes on nothing when there is nothing to teach.

The bottle disappears into a Melusine's satchel and the song starts before you can ask for it. By the second verse you have the trick; by the third they have moved on to the next bottle.
events.WHAT_THE_MELUSINES_TRADE_FOR.pages.INITI: The Melusines of Merusea Village have decided that bottles are the finest currency in Fontaine. Hand one over, they promise, and they will sing you the trick that kept a friend alive down in the Primordial Sea — Sigewinne taught them triage, and the songs stick better than any lecture. Three bottles on your belt catch their eyes, the leftmost ones first.
Lose {Potion}. Obtain an Upgraded {Rarity} {Type} card reward.

events.WHIRLPOOL_BELOW_YAOGUANG_SHOAL.pages.INI: The current off Yaoguang Shoal has been turning the same slow circle for as long as the local diviners can attest, and they've taken to renting out a front-row rock to anyone curious enough to pay for the privilege. "Watch it turn a card into something stranger," the attendant offers, gesturing at a plain Strike or Defend you're carrying, "or just drink from it and be done." Terms are posted on a board nobody has ever needed to read twice.
Enchant a Basic Strike (Ironclad) or Defend (Ironclad) with Spiral.
events.WHIRLPOOL_BELOW_YAOGUANG_SHOAL.pages.OBS: Enchant a Basic Strike (Ironclad) or Defend (Ironclad) with Spiral.
events.WHIRLPOOL_BELOW_YAOGUANG_SHOAL.title: The Whirlpool Below Yaoguang Shoal
events.WINDFALCONS_ROOST.pages.INITIAL.descript: Stormbearer Point, where the wind never quite sets down. A Guild scout walks you up a shale ledge to a nest of driftwood and torn sailcloth — a Falcon of the West's, by the span of it — and inside sits one pale egg as tall as your knee. The mother is out over Falcon Coast, circling wide. You have roughly as long as it takes her to turn.
Add Windfalcon Egg (Byrdonis Egg) to deck.
events.WINDFALCONS_ROOST.pages.TAKE.description: Add Windfalcon Egg (Byrdonis Egg) to deck.
events.WINDFALCONS_ROOST.title: The Windfalcon's Roost
events.WISTERIA_WELL_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.EXT: You draw your arm out with petals stuck to it, and the tanuki exhales. It pays what every visitor gets and does not mention the rest.
You draw your arm out numb to the shoulder. The tanuki pays out more than it has ever admitted to holding and pretends it did not see how deep you went.
events.WISTERIA_WELL_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.INI: Deep in Chinju Forest a wisteria bud has grown to the size of a shrine gate, its petals crackling faintly with trapped Electro. The tanuki who tends it will not say how old it is, only that every visitor takes the same choice: skim what's easy, or go in after the sweetness at the center. It does not warn you what waits at the bottom. It only watches, ears back, to see how far you'll reach.
Lose 5 HP. Advance to the next level.
events.WISTERIA_WELL_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.POL: The bud opens the rest of the way and lets you go. The core is warm and faintly crackling in your hands, and the tanuki, for once, has nothing to say.
events.WISTERIA_WELL_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.pages.REA: The trapped Electro crackles up your sleeve past the outer petals. The tanuki keeps its counting hushed and its eyes on the bud, not on you.
Lose 6 HP. Advance to the next level.
Shoulder-deep, and the wisteria is humming like a shrine bell. The tanuki has stopped counting. Something at the bud's heart is warm and turning slowly.
Lose 7 HP. Obtain the Wisteria Core.
events.WISTERIA_WELL_OF_CHINJU_FOREST.title: The Wisteria Well of Chinju Forest
events.WITHERING_GRAFT.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: In a hollow below Chatrakam Cave, a withered branch has swollen into a soft black bulb that pulses in time with your heartbeat. A Forest Ranger's abandoned trail-marker warns of it in three languages and one Aranara pictogram. As you lean in, the growth leans back — patient, and very interested in the hand that holds your weapon.
events.WITHERING_GRAFT.title: The Withering Graft
events.WOLF_RING_ABOVE_WINDRISE.pages.GROUP.des: You empty your purse into the grass and let the ring do as it likes. Lose ALL of your Gold (Mora). Transform 2 cards.
events.WOLF_RING_ABOVE_WINDRISE.pages.INITIAL.d: A perfect ring of pines stands above Windrise where no windmill was ever built, and Adventurers' Guild hunters camped nearby swear the ring moves half a pace every full moon. One hunter, well into her cups from the Angel's Share, waves you toward the center and says the ring pays generously for company — and asks nothing at all of anyone who just keeps walking.
events.WOLF_RING_ABOVE_WINDRISE.pages.INITIAL.o: You empty your purse into the grass and let the ring do as it likes. Lose ALL of your Gold (Mora). Transform 2 cards.
You walk on toward Windrise and let the quiet do its own work. Gain 5 Max HP.
events.WOLF_RING_ABOVE_WINDRISE.pages.LONER.des: You walk on toward Windrise and let the quiet do its own work. Gain 5 Max HP.
events.WOLF_RING_ABOVE_WINDRISE.title: The Wolf-Ring Above Windrise
